5.124.s:
. sūta uvāca .. ..
tataḥ karṇotpalātīrthaṃ vikhyātaṃ cāsti śobhanam ..
yatra snāto naraḥ samyaṅna viyogamavāpnuyāt .. 1 ..
5.124.d:
. सूत उवाच .. ..
ततः कर्णोत्पलातीर्थं विख्यातं चास्ति शोभनम् ..
यत्र स्नातो नरः सम्यङ्न वियोगमवाप्नुयात् .. 1 ..
5.124.m: Sūta said: / Next is the renowned and auspicious Karṇotpalātīrtha, / bathed in which a man duly never undergoes separation,

5.124.s:
kathaṃcidapi ceṣṭena dhanenālijanena ca ..
parākrameṇa dharmeṇa kalatreṇa viśeṣataḥ .. 2 ..
5.124.d:
कथंचिदपि चेष्टेन धनेनालिजनेन च ..
पराक्रमेण धर्मेण कलत्रेण विशेषतः .. 2 ..
5.124.m: in any way, from a beloved [object], from wealth, from female companions, / from prowess, from righteousness, and especially from a wife.

5.124.s:
satyasaṃdha iti khyātaḥ purāsītpṛthivīpatiḥ ..
ikṣvākukulasaṃbhūtaḥ sarvarūpaguṇairyutaḥ .. 3 ..
5.124.d:
सत्यसंध इति ख्यातः पुरासीत्पृथिवीपतिः ..
इक्ष्वाकुकुलसंभूतः सर्वरूपगुणैर्युतः .. 3 ..
5.124.m: Formerly there was an earthly sovereign renowned as Satyasaṃdha, / born in the lineage of Ikṣvāku, endowed with all beauty and virtues.

5.124.s:
tasya karṇotpalānāma jātā kanyā suśobhanā ..
bahuputrasya caikā sā sarvalakṣaṇalakṣitā .. 4 ..
5.124.d:
तस्य कर्णोत्पलानाम जाता कन्या सुशोभना ..
बहुपुत्रस्य चैका सा सर्वलक्षणलक्षिता .. 4 ..
5.124.m: To him, who had many sons, was born a single, very beautiful maiden / named Karṇotpalā, marked with all auspicious signs.

5.124.s:
atha tasyāḥ pitā nāma cakre dvādaśame dine ..
saṃmaṃtrya brāhmaṇaiḥ sārdhaṃ bhṛtyāmātyairmuhurmuhuḥ .. 5 ..
5.124.d:
अथ तस्याः पिता नाम चक्रे द्वादशमे दिने ..
संमंत्र्य ब्राह्मणैः सार्धं भृत्यामात्यैर्मुहुर्मुहुः .. 5 ..
5.124.m: Then, on the twelfth day, her father gave [her] a name, / having repeatedly taken counsel together with brahmins, servants, and ministers:

5.124.s:
yasmātkarṇotpalā ceyaṃ jātā mama kumārikā ..
tasmātkarṇotpalānāma jātā kanyā suśobhanā .. 6 ..
5.124.d:
यस्मात्कर्णोत्पला चेयं जाता मम कुमारिका ..
तस्मात्कर्णोत्पलानाम जाता कन्या सुशोभना .. 6 ..
5.124.m: “Since this girl was born to me resembling a blue lotus at the ear (karṇotpala), / therefore she is born a very beautiful maiden named Karṇotpalā.

5.124.s:
bahu putrasya caikā sā sarvalakṣaṇalakṣitā ..
tasmātkarṇotpalānāma jāyatāṃ dvijasattamāḥ .. 7 ..
5.124.d:
बहु पुत्रस्य चैका सा सर्वलक्षणलक्षिता ..
तस्मात्कर्णोत्पलानाम जायतां द्विजसत्तमाः .. 7 ..
5.124.m: She is the only daughter of [me] who have many sons, marked with all auspicious signs; / therefore, O best of the twice-born, let her name be Karṇotpalā.”

5.124.s:
kṛtanāmā'tha sā bālā vṛddhiṃ yāti dinedine ..
āhlādakāriṇī nityaṃ kalā cāṃdramasī yathā .. 8 ..
5.124.d:
कृतनामाऽथ सा बाला वृद्धिं याति दिनेदिने ..
आह्लादकारिणी नित्यं कला चांद्रमसी यथा .. 8 ..
5.124.m: Having thus been named, that young girl grew day by day, / ever bringing delight, like a digit of the moon.

5.124.s:
atha sā kramaśaḥ prāptā yauvanaṃ baṃdhulālitā ..
hastāddhastaṃ pragacchaṃtī sarveṣāṃ dvijasattamāḥ.. .. 9 ..
5.124.d:
अथ सा क्रमशः प्राप्ता यौवनं बंधुलालिता ..
हस्ताद्धस्तं प्रगच्छंती सर्वेषां द्विजसत्तमाः.. .. 9 ..
5.124.m: Then gradually she attained youth, pampered by her relatives, / passing from hand to hand of all, O best of the twice-born.

5.124.s:
atha tāṃ yauvanopetāṃ dṛṣṭvā sa pṛthivīpatiḥ .
ciṃtayāmāsa cittena kasyemāṃ pradadāmyaham .. 6.125.10 ..
5.124.d:
अथ तां यौवनोपेतां दृष्ट्वा स पृथिवीपतिः .
चिंतयामास चित्तेन कस्येमां प्रददाम्यहम् .. 6.125.10 ..
5.124.m: Then, having seen her endowed with youth, that sovereign of the earth / pondered in his mind: “To whom shall I give this girl?

5.124.s:
na tasyāḥ sadṛśaḥ kaścidvaro'tra dharaṇītale ..
na svarge na ca pātāle kiṃ kṛtyaṃ me'dhunā bhavet . 11 ..
5.124.d:
न तस्याः सदृशः कश्चिद्वरोऽत्र धरणीतले ..
न स्वर्गे न च पाताले किं कृत्यं मेऽधुना भवेत् . 11 ..
5.124.m: There is no groom equal to her here on the surface of the earth, / nor in heaven, nor in Pātāla. What should be done by me now?”

5.124.s:
sa evaṃ bahudhā dhyātvā tadarthaṃ pṛthivīpatiḥ ..
niścayaṃ prākaroccitte praṣṭavyo'tra pitāmahaḥ .. 12
5.124.d:
स एवं बहुधा ध्यात्वा तदर्थं पृथिवीपतिः ..
निश्चयं प्राकरोच्चित्ते प्रष्टव्योऽत्र पितामहः .. 12
5.124.m: Having pondered in many ways for that purpose, that lord of the earth / made a decision in his mind: “The Grandfather (Brahmā) ought to be asked here.

5.124.s:
mayādya viṣaye cāsminsa devaḥ prerayiṣyati ..
tasmai putrīṃ pradāsyāmi nānyasmai vai kathaṃcana .. 13 ..
5.124.d:
मयाद्य विषये चास्मिन्स देवः प्रेरयिष्यति ..
तस्मै पुत्रीं प्रदास्यामि नान्यस्मै वै कथंचन .. 13 ..
5.124.m: Whomever that god shall direct me to today in this matter, / to him I will give my daughter, and certainly to no other in any way.”

5.124.s:
sa evaṃ niścayaṃ kṛtvā tāmādāya tataḥ param ..
brahmalokaṃ jagāmātha praṣṭuṃ tasyāḥ kṛte varam .. 14 ..
5.124.d:
स एवं निश्चयं कृत्वा तामादाय ततः परम् ..
ब्रह्मलोकं जगामाथ प्रष्टुं तस्याः कृते वरम् .. 14 ..
5.124.m: Having thus made his resolve, taking her after that, / he then went to Brahmaloka to ask for a groom for her.

5.124.s:
atha yāvatsa saṃprāpto brahmalokaṃ nareśvaraḥ ..
tāvatsaṃdhyā samutpannā brāhmī brāhmaṇasattamāḥ .. 15 ..
5.124.d:
अथ यावत्स संप्राप्तो ब्रह्मलोकं नरेश्वरः ..
तावत्संध्या समुत्पन्ना ब्राह्मी ब्राह्मणसत्तमाः .. 15 ..
5.124.m: Now, just as that ruler of men reached Brahmaloka, / at that moment the evening twilight of Brahmā arose, O best of brahmins.

5.124.s:
etasminnaṃtare brahmā sāyaṃtanakriyotsukaḥ ..
upaviṣṭaḥ samādhisthastatkālaṃ samapadyata .. 16 ..
5.124.d:
एतस्मिन्नंतरे ब्रह्मा सायंतनक्रियोत्सुकः ..
उपविष्टः समाधिस्थस्तत्कालं समपद्यत .. 16 ..
5.124.m: Meanwhile, Brahmā, eager for his evening ritual, / seated and immersed in absorption (samādhi), remained at that time.

5.124.s:
satyasaṃdho'pi taṃ dṛṣṭvā samādhisthaṃ pitāmaham ..
samādhyaṃtaṃ pratīkṣansa upaviṣṭaḥ samīpataḥ .. 17 ..
5.124.d:
सत्यसंधोऽपि तं दृष्ट्वा समाधिस्थं पितामहम् ..
समाध्यंतं प्रतीक्षन्स उपविष्टः समीपतः .. 17 ..
5.124.m: Satyasaṃdha too, having seen the Grandfather immersed in absorption, / sat down near him, awaiting the end of the absorption.

5.124.s:
tato vilokya cātmānamātmani prapitāmahaḥ ..
padme pravartite samyagaṣṭapatre hṛdi sthite .. 18 ..
5.124.d:
ततो विलोक्य चात्मानमात्मनि प्रपितामहः ..
पद्मे प्रवर्तिते सम्यगष्टपत्रे हृदि स्थिते .. 18 ..
5.124.m: Then, beholding the Self within the self, the Great-grandfather, / in the fully opened eight-petalled lotus situated in the heart,

5.124.s:
karṇikāmadhyagaṃ dīptaṃ bahuvarṇamatisthiram ..
ānaṃdāśrupariklinnavadanaḥ pulakāṃkitaḥ .. 19 ..
5.124.d:
कर्णिकामध्यगं दीप्तं बहुवर्णमतिस्थिरम् ..
आनंदाश्रुपरिक्लिन्नवदनः पुलकांकितः .. 19 ..
5.124.m: standing in the middle of the pericarp, radiant, of manifold hues, extremely steady, / his face moist with tears of joy, his hair thrilling with horripilation,

5.124.s:
tata ācamya prakṣālya caraṇau sarvatodiśam ..
apaśyatpraṇataḥ sarvairbrahmalokanivāsibhiḥ ..6.125.20 ..
5.124.d:
तत आचम्य प्रक्षाल्य चरणौ सर्वतोदिशम् ..
अपश्यत्प्रणतः सर्वैर्ब्रह्मलोकनिवासिभिः ..6.125.20 ..
5.124.m: then having sipped water and washed his feet, looked in all directions, / bowed to by all the dwellers of Brahmaloka.

5.124.s:
etasminnaṃtare rājā tāmādāya śubhānanām ..
namaskṛtya tayā sārdhaṃ tataḥ provāca sādaram .. 21 ..
5.124.d:
एतस्मिन्नंतरे राजा तामादाय शुभाननाम् ..
नमस्कृत्य तया सार्धं ततः प्रोवाच सादरम् .. 21 ..
5.124.m: In the meantime, taking that fair-faced girl / and bowing down along with her, the king then spoke with reverence:

5.124.s:
ahaṃ deva samāyāto martyalokāttavāṃtikam ..
satyasaṃdho mahīpāla ānarta bhuvi viśrutaḥ .. 22 ..
5.124.d:
अहं देव समायातो मर्त्यलोकात्तवांतिकम् ..
सत्यसंधो महीपाल आनर्त भुवि विश्रुतः .. 22 ..
5.124.m: “O god, I have come from the mortal realm into your presence; / I am the king Satyasaṃdha, renowned in the land of Ānarta.

5.124.s:
iyaṃ karṇotpalānāma mama kanyā suśobhanā ..
asyā bhuvi mayā labdho na samo'tra patiḥ kvacit .. 23 ..
5.124.d:
इयं कर्णोत्पलानाम मम कन्या सुशोभना ..
अस्या भुवि मया लब्धो न समोऽत्र पतिः क्वचित् .. 23 ..
5.124.m: This very beautiful maiden of mine is named Karṇotpalā; / no husband equal to her has been found by me anywhere here on earth.

5.124.s:
sadṛśastena cāyātastava pārśve surottama ..
tasmānme brūhi bharttāramasyā yena dadāmyaham .. 24 ..
5.124.d:
सदृशस्तेन चायातस्तव पार्श्वे सुरोत्तम ..
तस्मान्मे ब्रूहि भर्त्तारमस्या येन ददाम्यहम् .. 24 ..
5.124.m: And an equal one [is sought]; therefore, O best of gods, I have come to your side. / Therefore tell me a husband for her, to whom I may give [her].”

5.124.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā tataḥ provāca padmajaḥ ..
vihasya sarvadevānāṃ samāje dvijasattamāḥ . 25 ..
5.124.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा ततः प्रोवाच पद्मजः ..
विहस्य सर्वदेवानां समाजे द्विजसत्तमाः . 25 ..
5.124.m: Sūta said: / Hearing those words of his, the lotus-born [Brahmā] then said, / laughing, in the assembly of all the gods, O best of the twice-born:

5.124.s:
yadi pṛcchasi me bhūpa kanyādharmapatiṃ prati ..
tannaiṣā kasyaciddeyā sāṃprataṃ śṛṇu kāraṇam .. 26 ..
5.124.d:
यदि पृच्छसि मे भूप कन्याधर्मपतिं प्रति ..
तन्नैषा कस्यचिद्देया सांप्रतं शृणु कारणम् .. 26 ..
5.124.m: “If you ask me, O king, concerning a lawful husband for the maiden, / then she must not be given to anyone at present; listen to the reason.

5.124.s:
ātmaśreṇiprasūtāya vayojyeṣṭhāya bhūpate ..
kanyā deyā ca dharmāya yaśase kulavṛddhaye .. 27 ..
5.124.d:
आत्मश्रेणिप्रसूताय वयोज्येष्ठाय भूपते ..
कन्या देया च धर्माय यशसे कुलवृद्धये .. 27 ..
5.124.m: To one born in one's own class and older in age, O lord of the earth, / a girl is to be given, for righteousness, fame, and the increase of the family.

5.124.s:
seyaṃ tava sutā martye jyeṣṭhabhāvaṃ samāśritā ..
sarveṣāṃ bhūmipālānāṃ yattattvaṃ kāraṇaṃ śṛṇu .. 28 ..
5.124.d:
सेयं तव सुता मर्त्ये ज्येष्ठभावं समाश्रिता ..
सर्वेषां भूमिपालानां यत्तत्त्वं कारणं शृणु .. 28 ..
5.124.m: This daughter of yours has attained the status of seniority among mortals / with respect to all the rulers of the earth; listen to the factual reason for that.

5.124.s:
mamāṃtikaṃ prapannasya tava jātaṃ yugatrayam..
atītā bhūtale martyā ye dṛṣṭāḥ prāktvayā nṛpa .. 29 ..
5.124.d:
ममांतिकं प्रपन्नस्य तव जातं युगत्रयम्..
अतीता भूतले मर्त्या ये दृष्टाः प्राक्त्वया नृप .. 29 ..
5.124.m: Three ages (yugas) have passed for you since you came into my presence; / those mortals whom you saw previously on the face of the earth, O king, have passed away.

5.124.s:
anyā sṛṣṭiḥ samutpannā sāṃprataṃ dharaṇītale ..
na tvaṃ jānāsi māhātmyānmama lokasamudbhavāt.. 6.125.30 ..
5.124.d:
अन्या सृष्टिः समुत्पन्ना सांप्रतं धरणीतले ..
न त्वं जानासि माहात्म्यान्मम लोकसमुद्भवात्.. 6.125.30 ..
5.124.m: Another creation has now arisen on the surface of the earth; / you do not know [this] on account of the majesty born of my world.

5.124.s:
na devā mānuṣīṃ bhāryāṃ kurvanti ca kathaṃcana ..
śleṣmamūtrapurīṣāṇāṃ saṃsthānaṃ yā vigarhitā .. 31 ..
5.124.d:
न देवा मानुषीं भार्यां कुर्वन्ति च कथंचन ..
श्लेष्ममूत्रपुरीषाणां संस्थानं या विगर्हिता .. 31 ..
5.124.m: And the gods never take a human woman as wife, / who is despised as an abode of phlegm, urine, and feces.

5.124.s:
tasmādatraiva tiṣṭha tvaṃ sutayā sahito nṛpa ..
hastyaśvādi ca yatkiṃcittatsarvaṃ te kṣayaṃ gatam .. 32 ..
5.124.d:
तस्मादत्रैव तिष्ठ त्वं सुतया सहितो नृप ..
हस्त्यश्वादि च यत्किंचित्तत्सर्वं ते क्षयं गतम् .. 32 ..
5.124.m: Therefore, stay right here together with your daughter, O king; / elephants, horses, and whatever else you had—all that of yours has gone to ruin.

5.124.s:
putrāḥ pautrāstathā bhṛtyā ye cānye bāṃdhavāstava ..
te sarve nidhanaṃ prāptā ye cānye bhavatekṣitāḥ .. 33 ..
5.124.d:
पुत्राः पौत्रास्तथा भृत्या ये चान्ये बांधवास्तव ..
ते सर्वे निधनं प्राप्ता ये चान्ये भवतेक्षिताः .. 33 ..
5.124.m: Sons, grandsons, servants, and whatever other kinsmen you had— / all those have met their death, as well as the others who were seen by you.”

5.124.s:
sa tatheti pratijñāya sthitaḥ pārthivasattamaḥ ..
yāvattāvatsuduḥkhārtā rudatīsā'bravītsutā .. 34 ..
5.124.d:
स तथेति प्रतिज्ञाय स्थितः पार्थिवसत्तमः ..
यावत्तावत्सुदुःखार्ता रुदतीसाऽब्रवीत्सुता .. 34 ..
5.124.m: Assenting to this, saying ‘So be it,’ the best of kings remained. / Meanwhile, the daughter, afflicted with deep grief, weeping, said:

5.124.s:
nāhaṃ tāta vasiṣyāmi sthānesminbrahmasaṃbhave ..
sakhījanaparityaktā baṃdhuvargavinākṛtā .. 35 ..
5.124.d:
नाहं तात वसिष्यामि स्थानेस्मिन्ब्रह्मसंभवे ..
सखीजनपरित्यक्ता बंधुवर्गविनाकृता .. 35 ..
5.124.m: “O father, I will not live in this place originating from Brahmā, / abandoned by my female friends and separated from the circle of kinsfolk.

5.124.s:
tasmādyāsyāmi tatraiva yatra sā jananī mama ..
tāśca sakhyaḥ kṛtānaṃdā yābhiḥ saṃkrīḍitaṃ mayā .. 36 ..
5.124.d:
तस्माद्यास्यामि तत्रैव यत्र सा जननी मम ..
ताश्च सख्यः कृतानंदा याभिः संक्रीडितं मया .. 36 ..
5.124.m: Therefore I will go right there where that mother of mine is, / and those joyful friends with whom I played.

5.124.s:
bhartrā vinākṛtā nāhaṃ nayiṣye kālasaṃsthitim ..
tasmāttatra drutaṃ gaccha yatra me jananī sthitā .. 37 ..
5.124.d:
भर्त्रा विनाकृता नाहं नयिष्ये कालसंस्थितिम् ..
तस्मात्तत्र द्रुतं गच्छ यत्र मे जननी स्थिता .. 37 ..
5.124.m: Deprived of a husband, I will not spend the duration of time; / therefore go swiftly there where my mother stays!”

5.124.s:
tasyāstadvacanaṃ śrutvā snehārdreṇa sa cetasā ..
tāmādāya tataḥ prāptaḥ svaṃ deśaṃ pārthivottamaḥ .. 38 ..
5.124.d:
तस्यास्तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा स्नेहार्द्रेण स चेतसा ..
तामादाय ततः प्राप्तः स्वं देशं पार्थिवोत्तमः .. 38 ..
5.124.m: Hearing her words, with a mind softened by affection, / the best of kings took her and arrived at his own country. 38

5.124.s:
yāvatpaśyati tāvatsa sthalasthāne jalāśayān ..
jalasthāneṣu saṃjātāḥ sthalasaṃghāḥ sudurgamāḥ .. 39 ..
5.124.d:
यावत्पश्यति तावत्स स्थलस्थाने जलाशयान् ..
जलस्थानेषु संजाताः स्थलसंघाः सुदुर्गमाः .. 39 ..
5.124.m: As he looked around, he saw reservoirs of water in places where dry land had been, / and impassable tracts of land had arisen in place of water. 39

5.124.s:
anye lokāstathā dharmāsteṣāṃ madhye vyavasthitāḥ ..
pṛcchannapi na jānāti saṃbaṃdhaṃ kenacitsaha .. 6.125.40 ..
5.124.d:
अन्ये लोकास्तथा धर्मास्तेषां मध्ये व्यवस्थिताः ..
पृच्छन्नपि न जानाति संबंधं केनचित्सह .. 6.125.40 ..
5.124.m: Other people and their customs were established among them. / Even though he asked, he recognized no connection with anyone. 40

5.124.s:
tathā martyānilaspṛṣṭandyatattkaṇātsa mahīpatiḥ ..
sā ca kanyā jarāgrastā saṃjātā śvetamūrddhajā .. 41 ..
5.124.d:
तथा मर्त्यानिलस्पृष्टन्द्यतत्त्कणात्स महीपतिः ..
सा च कन्या जराग्रस्ता संजाता श्वेतमूर्द्धजा .. 41 ..
5.124.m: Then, having been touched by the air of the mortal world, at that very moment that king / and that maiden were seized by old age, their hair turning white, 41

5.124.s:
valibhiḥ pūrṇitāṃgī ca śīrṇadaṃtā kucacyutā ..
amanojñā virūpāṃgī cipiṭākṣī dvijottamāḥ .. 42 ..
5.124.d:
वलिभिः पूर्णितांगी च शीर्णदंता कुचच्युता ..
अमनोज्ञा विरूपांगी चिपिटाक्षी द्विजोत्तमाः .. 42 ..
5.124.m: her body covered with wrinkles, her teeth decaying, her breasts fallen, / unlovely, deformed in body, and flat-eyed, O best of brahmins. 42

5.124.s:
sopi rājā tathābhūto vepamānaḥ padepade ..
papraccha bhūpatiḥ kotra deśaḥ koyaṃ puraṃ ca kim .. 43 ..
5.124.d:
सोपि राजा तथाभूतो वेपमानः पदेपदे ..
पप्रच्छ भूपतिः कोत्र देशः कोयं पुरं च किम् .. 43 ..
5.124.m: The king too, in the same state, trembling at every step, / the monarch asked: “What country is this here? What city is this? 43

5.124.s:
atha procurjanāstasya deśa ānarta ityayam ..
ayaṃ bhūpotra vikhyātaḥ sudharmajño bṛhadbalaḥ .. 44 ..
5.124.d:
अथ प्रोचुर्जनास्तस्य देश आनर्त इत्ययम् ..
अयं भूपोत्र विख्यातः सुधर्मज्ञो बृहद्बलः .. 44 ..
5.124.m: Then the people said to him: “This country is Ānarta. / Here, the famous king who knows dharma well is Bṛhadbala. 44

5.124.s:
etatprāptipuraṃnāma eṣā sābhramatī nadī ..
gartātīrthamidaṃ puṇyametasyāḥ parikīrtitam .. 49 ..
yatraite munayaḥ śāṃtā dāṃtāścāṣṭaguṇe ratāḥ ..
taparatā mahābhāgāḥ snānajapyayaparāyaṇāḥ .. .. 46 ..
tataḥ sa tu samākarṇya ruroda kṛtaniḥsvanaḥ ..
svasutāṃ tāṃ samāliṃgya duḥkhaśokasamanvitaḥ .. 47 ..
tau ca vṛddhatamau dṛṣṭvā rudatau kṛpayānvitāḥ ..
sarve lokāḥ samājagmuḥ papracchuśca suduḥkhitāḥ .. 48 ..
kiṃ tvaṃ vṛddha suduḥkhārtaḥ prarodiṣi nirargalam ..
anayā vṛddhayā sārdhaṃ tasmānnaḥ kāraṇaṃ vada .. 49 ..
5.124.d:
एतत्प्राप्तिपुरंनाम एषा साभ्रमती नदी ..
गर्तातीर्थमिदं पुण्यमेतस्याः परिकीर्तितम् .. 49 ..
यत्रैते मुनयः शांता दांताश्चाष्टगुणे रताः ..
तपरता महाभागाः स्नानजप्ययपरायणाः .. .. 46 ..
ततः स तु समाकर्ण्य रुरोद कृतनिःस्वनः ..
स्वसुतां तां समालिंग्य दुःखशोकसमन्वितः .. 47 ..
तौ च वृद्धतमौ दृष्ट्वा रुदतौ कृपयान्विताः ..
सर्वे लोकाः समाजग्मुः पप्रच्छुश्च सुदुःखिताः .. 48 ..
किं त्वं वृद्ध सुदुःखार्तः प्ररोदिषि निरर्गलम् ..
अनया वृद्धया सार्धं तस्मान्नः कारणं वद .. 49 ..
5.124.m:
This is named the town of Prāptipura; this river is the Sābhramatī. / This is proclaimed to be the sacred Gartātīrtha upon it, 45
where these sages, tranquil, self-restrained, devoted to the eight virtues, / devoted to austerity, fortunate, are intent upon ritual ablution and silent recitation.” 46
Hearing this, he wept aloud, / embracing his daughter, filled with sorrow and grief. 47
Seeing the two of them, deeply aged and weeping, filled with pity, / all the people came together and, deeply troubled, asked: 48
“Why, old man, afflicted with deep sorrow, do you weep unrestrainedly / together with this old woman? Therefore tell us the cause. 49

5.124.s:
kiṃ te naṣṭaḥ priyaḥ kaścitkiṃ vā jāto dhanakṣayaḥ ..
parābhūtosi vā kiṃ tvaṃ kenāpi vada mā ciram .. 6.125.50 ..
5.124.d:
किं ते नष्टः प्रियः कश्चित्किं वा जातो धनक्षयः ..
पराभूतोसि वा किं त्वं केनापि वद मा चिरम् .. 6.125.50 ..
5.124.m: Has some loved one of yours perished, or has there been a loss of wealth? / Or have you been humiliated by someone? Speak without delay! 50

5.124.s:
dharmajño duṣṭahaṃtā ca sādhūnāṃ pālane rataḥ ..
rājā bṛhadbalosmākaṃ yena te kurute sukham .. 51 .. ..
5.124.d:
धर्मज्ञो दुष्टहंता च साधूनां पालने रतः ..
राजा बृहद्बलोस्माकं येन ते कुरुते सुखम् .. 51 .. ..
5.124.m: Knowing dharma, slayer of the wicked, and devoted to protecting the virtuous, / our king is Bṛhadbala, so that he may bring you happiness.” 51

5.124.s:
satyasaṃdha uvāca .. ..
ānarttādhipatiścāhaṃ satyasaṃdha iti smṛtaḥ ..
mama karṇotpalānāma suteyaṃ dayitā sadā ..
sohamasyāḥ pradānārthaṃ brahmalokamito gataḥ ..
praṣṭuṃ pitāmahaṃ devaṃ sthitastatra muhūrtavat .. 93 ..
tato bhūyaḥ samāyāto yāvatpaśyāmi bhūtalam ..
tāvadvilomatāṃ prāptaṃ sarvaṃ no vedmi kiñcana .. 54 ..
tacchrutvā te janā gatvā vismayotphullalocanāḥ ..
bṛhadbalāya tatsarvamācakhyustuṣṭisaṃyutāḥ .. 55 ..
so'pi tatsarvamākarṇya tataḥ śīghrataraṃ gataḥ ..
padbhyāmeva sthito yatra satyasandho mahīpatiḥ .. 56 ..
tatastaṃ praṇipatyoccaiḥ kṛtāṃjalipuṭaḥ sthitaḥ ..
svāgataṃ te mahīpāla bhūyaḥ susvāgataṃ ca te .. 57 ..
idaṃ rājyaṃ nijaṃ bhūyo mayā bhṛtyena sādaram ..
kuruṣva svecchayā dehi dānāni vividhāni ca .. 58 ..
5.124.d:
सत्यसंध उवाच .. ..
आनर्त्ताधिपतिश्चाहं सत्यसंध इति स्मृतः ..
मम कर्णोत्पलानाम सुतेयं दयिता सदा ..
सोहमस्याः प्रदानार्थं ब्रह्मलोकमितो गतः ..
प्रष्टुं पितामहं देवं स्थितस्तत्र मुहूर्तवत् .. 93 ..
ततो भूयः समायातो यावत्पश्यामि भूतलम् ..
तावद्विलोमतां प्राप्तं सर्वं नो वेद्मि किञ्चन .. 54 ..
तच्छ्रुत्वा ते जना गत्वा विस्मयोत्फुल्ललोचनाः ..
बृहद्बलाय तत्सर्वमाचख्युस्तुष्टिसंयुताः .. 55 ..
सोऽपि तत्सर्वमाकर्ण्य ततः शीघ्रतरं गतः ..
पद्भ्यामेव स्थितो यत्र सत्यसन्धो महीपतिः .. 56 ..
ततस्तं प्रणिपत्योच्चैः कृतांजलिपुटः स्थितः ..
स्वागतं ते महीपाल भूयः सुस्वागतं च ते .. 57 ..
इदं राज्यं निजं भूयो मया भृत्येन सादरम् ..
कुरुष्व स्वेच्छया देहि दानानि विविधानि च .. 58 ..
5.124.m:
Satyasandha said: / “I am the ruler of Ānarta, known as Satyasandha. / This is my daughter named Karṇotpalā, ever cherished. / I went from here to the realm of Brahmā to give her in marriage, / to consult the god, the Grandfather, and I stayed there for mere moments. 52–53
Then, having returned here, as I look upon the earth, / everything has undergone complete change; I recognize nothing at all.” 54
Hearing that, those people went, their eyes wide with wonder, / and full of satisfaction related all of that to Bṛhadbala. 55
He too, having heard it all, went very swiftly, / on foot alone, to where King Satyasandha stood. 56
Then, having bowed low before him, he stood with folded hands: / “Welcome to you, protector of the earth, and once again, a heartfelt welcome to you! 57
This kingdom is your own; ruled once more by me, your respectful servant, / govern it according to your will, and give various gifts.” 58

5.124.s:
tatastaṃ ca samāliṃgya śirasyādhāya cāsakṛt ..
uvācāśrupariklinnavadano gadgadākṣaram .. 59 ..
vatsa cīrṇaṃ mayā rājyaṃ dānaṃ dattaṃ pṛthagvidham ..
vājimedhamukhairyajñairiṣṭaṃ saṃpūrṇadakṣiṇaiḥ ..6.125.6...
tasmāttapaścariṣyāmi sutayā cānayā saha ..
yathaiṣā labhate bhūyastāruṇyaṃ prāktanaṃ śubham ..6...
.. bṛhadbala uvāca .. ..
pāraṃparyeṇa rājeṃdra mayaitatsakalaṃ śrutam ..
satyasaṃdho mahīpālaḥ kanyāmādāya nirgataḥ .. 62 ..
kutracinna samāyātaḥ sa bhūyo'pi purottame ..
tatastatsacivai rājyaṃ pratipālya ciraṃ nṛpa ..
abhiṣiktastataḥ putraḥ suhayonāma viśrutaḥ .. 63 ..
tasyāhaṃ kramaśo jātaḥ saptasaptatimo vibho..
puruṣastava vaṃśasya samudbhūto mahāpatiḥ .. 64 ..
tasmādatraiva kalyāṇe sthāne'sminmedhyatāṃ gate ..
gartātīrthe kuru vibho tapastvamanayā saha .. 65 ..
5.124.d:
ततस्तं च समालिंग्य शिरस्याधाय चासकृत् ..
उवाचाश्रुपरिक्लिन्नवदनो गद्गदाक्षरम् .. 59 ..
वत्स चीर्णं मया राज्यं दानं दत्तं पृथग्विधम् ..
वाजिमेधमुखैर्यज्ञैरिष्टं संपूर्णदक्षिणैः ..6.125.6...
तस्मात्तपश्चरिष्यामि सुतया चानया सह ..
यथैषा लभते भूयस्तारुण्यं प्राक्तनं शुभम् ..6...
.. बृहद्बल उवाच .. ..
पारंपर्येण राजेंद्र मयैतत्सकलं श्रुतम् ..
सत्यसंधो महीपालः कन्यामादाय निर्गतः .. 62 ..
कुत्रचिन्न समायातः स भूयोऽपि पुरोत्तमे ..
ततस्तत्सचिवै राज्यं प्रतिपाल्य चिरं नृप ..
अभिषिक्तस्ततः पुत्रः सुहयोनाम विश्रुतः .. 63 ..
तस्याहं क्रमशो जातः सप्तसप्ततिमो विभो..
पुरुषस्तव वंशस्य समुद्भूतो महापतिः .. 64 ..
तस्मादत्रैव कल्याणे स्थानेऽस्मिन्मेध्यतां गते ..
गर्तातीर्थे कुरु विभो तपस्त्वमनया सह .. 65 ..
5.124.m:
Then, having embraced him and kissed his head repeatedly, / with his face wet with tears, he spoke in a choked voice: 59
“Child, a kingdom has been enjoyed by me, and diverse gifts given; / I have sacrificed with rituals such as the horse sacrifice, with abundant priestly fees. 60
Therefore I shall practice austerity together with this daughter, / so that she may regain her former auspicious youth.” 61
Bṛhadbala said: / “Through continuous tradition, O lord of kings, I have heard all this: / King Satyasandha set out taking his maiden daughter; 62
he never returned anywhere to this foremost city. / Then, O king, the ministers preserved the kingdom for a long time, / and then his son named the famed Suhaya was consecrated. 63
In succession to him, O lord, I was born as the seventy-seventh / man born in your lineage, a great ruler. 64
Therefore, O lord, right here in this auspicious place that has attained sanctity, / at Gartātīrtha, practice austerity together with her, 65

5.124.s:
yena te caraṇau nityaṃ praṇipatya trisaṃdhijam..
śreyaḥ prāpnomyasaṃdigdhaṃ prasādaḥ kriyatāmiti .. 66 ..
.. satyasaṃdha uvāca .. ..
hāṭakeśvaraje kṣetre mayāsītsthāpitaṃ purā ..
liṃgaṃ vṛṣabhanāthasya tāvadasti suputraka .. 67 ..
tattasyārādhanaṃ nityaṃ kariṣyāmi divāniśam ..
tasmātprāpaya māṃ tatra anayā sutayā saha .. 68 ..
evaṃ tayoḥ pravadatoranyonyaṃ bhūmipālayoḥ ..
garttātīrthātsamāyātā brāhmaṇāḥ kautukānvitāḥ ..
śrutvā bhūmipatiṃ prāptaṃ ciraṃtanaguruṃ śubham.. 69 ..
tataḥ sa pārthivasteṣāṃ dattvārghaṃ prāṃjaliḥ sthitaḥ ..
provāca svargavṛttāṃtamāsyatāmiti sādaram .. 6.125.70 ..
atha te brāhmaṇāḥ sarve yathājyeṣṭhaṃ yathāsukham..
upaviṣṭā nareṃdrasya caturdikṣu suvismitāḥ ..
papracchustaṃ ca bhūpālaṃ vārtāṃ brahmagṛhodbhavām .. 71 ..
5.124.d:
येन ते चरणौ नित्यं प्रणिपत्य त्रिसंधिजम्..
श्रेयः प्राप्नोम्यसंदिग्धं प्रसादः क्रियतामिति .. 66 ..
.. सत्यसंध उवाच .. ..
हाटकेश्वरजे क्षेत्रे मयासीत्स्थापितं पुरा ..
लिंगं वृषभनाथस्य तावदस्ति सुपुत्रक .. 67 ..
तत्तस्याराधनं नित्यं करिष्यामि दिवानिशम् ..
तस्मात्प्रापय मां तत्र अनया सुतया सह .. 68 ..
एवं तयोः प्रवदतोरन्योन्यं भूमिपालयोः ..
गर्त्तातीर्थात्समायाता ब्राह्मणाः कौतुकान्विताः ..
श्रुत्वा भूमिपतिं प्राप्तं चिरंतनगुरुं शुभम्.. 69 ..
ततः स पार्थिवस्तेषां दत्त्वार्घं प्रांजलिः स्थितः ..
प्रोवाच स्वर्गवृत्तांतमास्यतामिति सादरम् .. 6.125.70 ..
अथ ते ब्राह्मणाः सर्वे यथाज्येष्ठं यथासुखम्..
उपविष्टा नरेंद्रस्य चतुर्दिक्षु सुविस्मिताः ..
पप्रच्छुस्तं च भूपालं वार्तां ब्रह्मगृहोद्भवाम् .. 71 ..
5.124.m:
so that, constantly bowing at your feet at the three junctures of the day, / I may undoubtedly attain welfare. Let your grace be shown!” 66
Satyasandha said: / “In the sacred field of Hāṭakeśvara, there was formerly established by me / a liṅga of Vṛṣabhanātha; does it still exist, good son? 67
I shall constantly worship it day and night; / therefore take me there together with this daughter.” 68
As the two kings were conversing with one another in this way, / the brahmins arrived from Gartātīrtha full of curiosity, / having heard that the king, their auspicious ancient forefather, had arrived. 69
Then that ruler of the earth, having given them guest-water, stood with folded hands, / and spoke respectfully of the news of heaven, saying, “Please be seated.” 70
Then all those brahmins, seated in order of seniority and at their ease / on the four sides of the king, filled with wonder, / asked that monarch for the news originating from Brahmā's abode, 71

5.124.s:
yathā sa tatra niryāta āgataśca yathā purā ..
ālāpāḥ padmayoneśca yathā jātāstvanekaśaḥ .. 72 ..
tataḥ kathāṃtamāsādya satyasaṃdho mahīpatiḥ ..
kiṃcidāsādya taṃ prāha samīpasthaṃ bṛhadbalam .. 73 ..
mayā iṣṭaṃ makhaiścitrairanekairbhūridakṣiṇaiḥ ..
dānāni ca vicitrāṇi yeṣāṃ saṃkhyā na vidyate .. 74 ..
ekadāhaṃ gataḥ putra camatkārapurottame ..
dṛṣṭaṃ mayā puraṃ tacca samaṃtādbrāhmaṇaivṛtam .. 75..
japasvādhyāyasaṃpannairagnihotraparāyaṇaiḥ ..
gṛhasthadharmasaṃpannairlokadvayaphalānvitaiḥ .. 76 ..
tataśca ciṃtitaṃ citte sa vanyo mama pūrvajaḥ ..
yenaiṣopārjitā kīrtiḥ śāśvatī kṣayavarjitā .. 77 ..
tasmādahamapi sthāpya puramīdṛksamucchritam ..
brāhmaṇebhyaḥ pradāsyāmi tatkīrtiparivṛddhaye .. 78 ..
evaṃ citayamānasya mama nityaṃ mahīpate ..
avāṃtareṇa saṃjātaṃ brahmalokaprayāṇakam .. 79 ..
5.124.d:
यथा स तत्र निर्यात आगतश्च यथा पुरा ..
आलापाः पद्मयोनेश्च यथा जातास्त्वनेकशः .. 72 ..
ततः कथांतमासाद्य सत्यसंधो महीपतिः ..
किंचिदासाद्य तं प्राह समीपस्थं बृहद्बलम् .. 73 ..
मया इष्टं मखैश्चित्रैरनेकैर्भूरिदक्षिणैः ..
दानानि च विचित्राणि येषां संख्या न विद्यते .. 74 ..
एकदाहं गतः पुत्र चमत्कारपुरोत्तमे ..
दृष्टं मया पुरं तच्च समंताद्ब्राह्मणैवृतम् .. 75..
जपस्वाध्यायसंपन्नैरग्निहोत्रपरायणैः ..
गृहस्थधर्मसंपन्नैर्लोकद्वयफलान्वितैः .. 76 ..
ततश्च चिंतितं चित्ते स वन्यो मम पूर्वजः ..
येनैषोपार्जिता कीर्तिः शाश्वती क्षयवर्जिता .. 77 ..
तस्मादहमपि स्थाप्य पुरमीदृक्समुच्छ्रितम् ..
ब्राह्मणेभ्यः प्रदास्यामि तत्कीर्तिपरिवृद्धये .. 78 ..
एवं चितयमानस्य मम नित्यं महीपते ..
अवांतरेण संजातं ब्रह्मलोकप्रयाणकम् .. 79 ..
5.124.m:
how he had departed there, and how he had come as before, / and the various conversations that had taken place with the Lotus-born [Brahmā]. 72
Then, reaching the end of the narrative, King Satyasandha, / approaching Bṛhadbala who stood nearby, said a few words to him: 73
“I have sacrificed with manifold splendid rites endowed with abundant priestly fees, / and [given] various gifts of which there is no counting. 74
Once, O son, I went to the supreme city of Camatkārapura; / and I saw that city surrounded on all sides by brahmins, 75
endowed with silent recitation and study of the Veda, devoted to the fire sacrifice, / endowed with the duties of the householder, possessing the fruits of both worlds. 76
And then it was thought in my mind: Praiseworthy is that ancestor of mine / by whom this eternal fame, free from decay, was acquired. 77
Therefore, I too, having established such an elevated city, / shall give it to the brahmins for the increase of that fame. 78
As I was constantly contemplating in this manner, O king, / in the meantime the journey to the realm of Brahmā came to pass. 79”

5.124.s:
etadekaṃ hi me citte paścāttāpakaraṃ sthitam..
nānyatkiṃcinmahīpāla kṛtakṛtyasya sarvataḥ .. 6.125.80 ..
tasmātprārthaya vipreṃdrānkāṃścideṣāṃ mahātmanām ..
yena yacchāmi susthānaṃ kṛtvā tebhyastavājñayā .. 81 ..
tataḥ sa prārthayāmāsa tadarthaṃ brāhmaṇottamān ..
mamopari dayāṃ kṛtvā kriyatāṃ bhoḥ parigrahaḥ .. 82 ..
asya bhūpasya sadbhaktyā yacchataḥ puramuttamam ..
ahaṃ vaḥ pālayiṣyāmi sarve madvaṃśajāśca te .. .. 83 ..
tataḥ kāṃścitsukṛcchreṇa samānīya bṛhadbalaḥ ..
rājñe nivedayāmāsa etebhyo dīyatāmiti .. 84 ..
tataḥ prakṣālya sarveṣāṃ pādānsa pṛthivīpatiḥ ..
satyasaṃdho dadau tebhyaḥ purārthaṃ bhūmimuttamām .. 85 ..
bṛhadbalasya cādeśaṃ dadau saṃprasthitaḥ svayam ..
tvayaitadyogyatāṃ neyaṃ puraṃ parapuraṃjaya .. 86 ..
5.124.d:
एतदेकं हि मे चित्ते पश्चात्तापकरं स्थितम्..
नान्यत्किंचिन्महीपाल कृतकृत्यस्य सर्वतः .. 6.125.80 ..
तस्मात्प्रार्थय विप्रेंद्रान्कांश्चिदेषां महात्मनाम् ..
येन यच्छामि सुस्थानं कृत्वा तेभ्यस्तवाज्ञया .. 81 ..
ततः स प्रार्थयामास तदर्थं ब्राह्मणोत्तमान् ..
ममोपरि दयां कृत्वा क्रियतां भोः परिग्रहः .. 82 ..
अस्य भूपस्य सद्भक्त्या यच्छतः पुरमुत्तमम् ..
अहं वः पालयिष्यामि सर्वे मद्वंशजाश्च ते .. .. 83 ..
ततः कांश्चित्सुकृच्छ्रेण समानीय बृहद्बलः ..
राज्ञे निवेदयामास एतेभ्यो दीयतामिति .. 84 ..
ततः प्रक्षाल्य सर्वेषां पादान्स पृथिवीपतिः ..
सत्यसंधो ददौ तेभ्यः पुरार्थं भूमिमुत्तमाम् .. 85 ..
बृहद्बलस्य चादेशं ददौ संप्रस्थितः स्वयम् ..
त्वयैतद्योग्यतां नेयं पुरं परपुरंजय .. 86 ..
5.124.m:
"This one regret alone remains in my mind; / nothing else at all [remains], O protector of the earth, for one whose purpose has been achieved in every way. (80)
Therefore, make a request to some of the foremost brahmins among these great-souled ones, / so that, having created an excellent settlement, I may grant it to them at your command." (81)
Then he besought the best of brahmins for that purpose: / "Taking pity upon me, sir, let this acceptance [of the gift] be made. (82)
As this king gives this excellent city out of true devotion, / I shall sustain you, as will all those born of my lineage." (83)
Then Bṛhadbala, bringing some [brahmins] with great difficulty, / announced to the king: "Let it be given to these." (84)
Then, having washed the feet of them all, that lord of the earth, / true to his promise, gave them excellent land for the sake of a city. (85)
Setting out himself, he gave an order to Bṛhadbala: / "You must bring this city to suitable perfection, O conqueror of enemy citadels." (86)

5.124.s:
gatvā ca sa tayā sārdhaṃ tatkṣetraṃ hāṭakeśvaram ..
talliṃgaṃ prāpya saṃhṛṣṭaściraṃ tepe tapastataḥ .. 87 ..
sāpi karṇotpalā prāpya kiṃcitpuṇyaṃ jalāśayam ..
tapastepe pratiṣṭhāpya gaurīṃ śraddhāsamanvitā .. 88 ..
etasminnaṃtare rājā kāladharmamupāgataḥ ..
ānartādhipatiryuddhe hataḥ putraiḥ samanvitaḥ .. 89 ..
tataste brāhmaṇāḥ sarve gartātīrthasamudbhavāḥ ..
satyasaṃdhaṃ samabhyetya procurduḥkhasamanvitāḥ .. 6.125.90 ..
parigrahaḥ kṛto'smābhiḥ kevalaṃ pṛthivīpate ..
na ca kiṃcitphalaṃ jātaṃ vṛttijaṃ naḥ purodbhavam .. 91 ..
tasmātkuru sthitiṃ tvaṃ ca svadharmaparivṛddhaye ..?.
yena tadvartanopāyo hyasmākaṃ nṛpasattama .. 92 ..
rājā bṛhadbalo yuddhe kāladharmamupāgataḥ ..
yastvayā darśito'smākaṃ vṛttyarthaṃ nṛpasattama .. 93 ..
5.124.d:
गत्वा च स तया सार्धं तत्क्षेत्रं हाटकेश्वरम् ..
तल्लिंगं प्राप्य संहृष्टश्चिरं तेपे तपस्ततः .. 87 ..
सापि कर्णोत्पला प्राप्य किंचित्पुण्यं जलाशयम् ..
तपस्तेपे प्रतिष्ठाप्य गौरीं श्रद्धासमन्विता .. 88 ..
एतस्मिन्नंतरे राजा कालधर्ममुपागतः ..
आनर्ताधिपतिर्युद्धे हतः पुत्रैः समन्वितः .. 89 ..
ततस्ते ब्राह्मणाः सर्वे गर्तातीर्थसमुद्भवाः ..
सत्यसंधं समभ्येत्य प्रोचुर्दुःखसमन्विताः .. 6.125.90 ..
परिग्रहः कृतोऽस्माभिः केवलं पृथिवीपते ..
न च किंचित्फलं जातं वृत्तिजं नः पुरोद्भवम् .. 91 ..
तस्मात्कुरु स्थितिं त्वं च स्वधर्मपरिवृद्धये ..?.
येन तद्वर्तनोपायो ह्यस्माकं नृपसत्तम .. 92 ..
राजा बृहद्बलो युद्धे कालधर्ममुपागतः ..
यस्त्वया दर्शितोऽस्माकं वृत्त्यर्थं नृपसत्तम .. 93 ..
5.124.m:
Having gone with her to that sacred field of Hāṭakeśvara, / delighted on reaching that liṅga, he then performed austerity for a long time. (87)
Karṇotpalā too, having reached a certain sacred body of water, / installed Gaurī and performed austerity endowed with faith. (88)
Meanwhile, the king succumbed to the law of Time: / the ruler of Ānarta was slain in battle along with his sons. (89)
Then all those brahmins originating from Gartātīrtha, / approaching Satyasandha, spoke filled with grief: (90)
"A gift was merely accepted by us, O protector of the earth, / and no fruit arose for us regarding livelihood arising from the city. (91)
Therefore, make an arrangement yourself for the increase of your own duty, / by which there may indeed be a means of livelihood for us, O best of kings! (92)
King Bṛhadbala has succumbed to the law of Time in battle— / he who was designated by you for our livelihood, O best of kings!" (93)

5.124.s:
.. satyasandha uvāca .. ..
saṃnyasto'haṃ dvijaśreṣṭhā vṛttiṃ kartuṃ na ca kṣamaḥ ..
yadi me syātpumānkaścidanvaye'pi na saṃśayaḥ .. 94 ..
5.124.d:
.. सत्यसन्ध उवाच .. ..
संन्यस्तोऽहं द्विजश्रेष्ठा वृत्तिं कर्तुं न च क्षमः ..
यदि मे स्यात्पुमान्कश्चिदन्वयेऽपि न संशयः .. 94 ..
5.124.m: Satyasandha said: / "I have renounced the world, O best of the twice-born, and am unable to provide a livelihood. / If only there were any male descendant in my lineage, there would be no doubt. (94)

5.124.s:
tasmādvrajatha harmyaṃ svaṃ prasādaḥ kriyatāṃ mama ..
abhāgyairbhavadīyaiśca hato rājā bṛhadbalaḥ .. 95 ..
5.124.d:
तस्माद्व्रजथ हर्म्यं स्वं प्रसादः क्रियतां मम ..
अभाग्यैर्भवदीयैश्च हतो राजा बृहद्बलः .. 95 ..
5.124.m: Therefore, go to your own dwelling; let favor be shown to me. / And through your own misfortunes, King Bṛhadbala was killed." (95)

5.124.s:
evamuktāśca te viprā matvā tathyaṃ ca tadvacaḥ ..
svasthānaṃ tvaritā jagmuḥ so'pi cakre tapaściram .. 96 ..
5.124.d:
एवमुक्ताश्च ते विप्रा मत्वा तथ्यं च तद्वचः ..
स्वस्थानं त्वरिता जग्मुः सोऽपि चक्रे तपश्चिरम् .. 96 ..
5.124.m: Thus addressed, those brahmins, considering his words to be true, / swiftly went to their own abode; he too performed austerity for a long time. (96)

5.124.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe śrīhāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye satyasandhanṛpativṛttāntavarṇanaṃnāma paṃcaviṃśatyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 125 ..
5.124.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां षष्ठे नागरखण्डे श्रीहाटकेश्वरक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये सत्यसन्धनृपतिवृत्तान्तवर्णनंनाम पंचविंशत्यधिकशततमोऽध्यायः .. 125 ..
5.124.m: Thus ends the one hundred and twenty-fifth chapter, entitled 'Description of the Story of King Satyasandha', in the Māhātmya of the Sacred Field of Śrī Hāṭakeśvara, in the Nāgarakhaṇḍa, the sixth [section], in the Mahāpurāṇa of Śrī Skanda, in the collection of eighty-one thousand [verses]. (125)

5.125.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
evaṃ tasya tapasthasya putryā saha dvijottamāḥ ..
ājagmurbrāhmaṇāḥ sarve camatkārapurodbhavāḥ .. 1 ..
5.125.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
एवं तस्य तपस्थस्य पुत्र्या सह द्विजोत्तमाः ..
आजग्मुर्ब्राह्मणाः सर्वे चमत्कारपुरोद्भवाः .. 1 ..
5.125.m: Sūta said: / As he was thus engaged in austerity together with his daughter, O best of the twice-born, / all the brahmins born in Camatkārapura came. (1)

5.125.s:
.. brāhmaṇā ūcuḥ .. ..
sandeheṣu ca sarveṣu vivādeṣu viśeṣataḥ ..
abhāvātpārthivendrasya saṃjātaśca parābhavaḥ .. 2 ..
5.125.d:
.. ब्राह्मणा ऊचुः .. ..
सन्देहेषु च सर्वेषु विवादेषु विशेषतः ..
अभावात्पार्थिवेन्द्रस्य संजातश्च पराभवः .. 2 ..
5.125.m: The brahmins said: / "In all doubts and especially in disputes, / through the absence of a sovereign king, ruin has come upon us." (2)

5.125.s:
tataśca dvijavaryaiḥ sa saṃnyastaḥ pṛthivīpatiḥ ..
pṛṣṭaśca prārthitaścaiva nijarājyasya rakṣaṇe ..
anyasmindivase prāha kṛtāṃjalipuṭaḥ sthitaḥ .. 3 ..
5.125.d:
ततश्च द्विजवर्यैः स संन्यस्तः पृथिवीपतिः ..
पृष्टश्च प्रार्थितश्चैव निजराज्यस्य रक्षणे ..
अन्यस्मिन्दिवसे प्राह कृतांजलिपुटः स्थितः .. 3 ..
5.125.m: Then that lord of the earth who had renounced the world was questioned / and implored by the best of the twice-born to protect his own kingdom; / on the next day, standing with folded hands, he spoke: (3)

5.125.s:
.. rājovāca .. .
anarho'haṃ dvijaśreṣṭhāḥ saṃdehaṃ hartumeva vaḥ ..
rakṣāṃ kartuṃ viśeṣeṇa tyaktaśastro'smi cādhunā .. 4 ...
5.125.d:
.. राजोवाच .. .
अनर्होऽहं द्विजश्रेष्ठाः संदेहं हर्तुमेव वः ..
रक्षां कर्तुं विशेषेण त्यक्तशस्त्रोऽस्मि चाधुना .. 4 ...
5.125.m: The king said: / "I am unfit, O best of the twice-born, to remove your doubt / or especially to offer protection; for I have now laid down weapons." (4)

5.125.s:
.. brāhmaṇā ūcuḥ .. ..
sarve vayaṃ mahārāja bhūpasyāpyadhikā yataḥ ..
ahaṃkāreṇa darpeṇa nijaṃ sthānaṃ samāśritāḥ .. 5 ..
5.125.d:
.. ब्राह्मणा ऊचुः .. ..
सर्वे वयं महाराज भूपस्याप्यधिका यतः ..
अहंकारेण दर्पेण निजं स्थानं समाश्रिताः .. 5 ..
5.125.m: The brahmins said: / "We all, O great king, are superior even to a king; / hence, out of pride and arrogance, we have resorted to our own abode. (5)

5.125.s:
na kasyacinmahārāja kadāpi ca kathaṃcana ..
vartanāyāśca sandehaḥ sthānakṛtye'pi saṃsthitaḥ .. 6 ..
5.125.d:
न कस्यचिन्महाराज कदापि च कथंचन ..
वर्तनायाश्च सन्देहः स्थानकृत्येऽपि संस्थितः .. 6 ..
5.125.m: To no one, O great king, at any time or in any manner, / was there doubt regarding livelihood or concerning the duties of the settlement. (6)

5.125.s:
asaṃkhyātā kṛtā vṛttiḥ purā'smākaṃ mahātmanā ..
tataḥ sā vṛddhimānītā tatparaiḥ pārthivottamaiḥ .. 7 ..
5.125.d:
असंख्याता कृता वृत्तिः पुराऽस्माकं महात्मना ..
ततः सा वृद्धिमानीता तत्परैः पार्थिवोत्तमैः .. 7 ..
5.125.m: An immeasurable livelihood was created for us of old by a great-souled one; / thereafter it was increased by the best of rulers devoted to him, (7)

5.125.s:
tvayā caiva viśeṣeṇa yāvadrājā bṛhadbalaḥ ..
ānartaviṣaye rājā yo yaḥ syātsa prayacchati .. 8 ..
5.125.d:
त्वया चैव विशेषेण यावद्राजा बृहद्बलः ..
आनर्तविषये राजा यो यः स्यात्स प्रयच्छति .. 8 ..
5.125.m: and especially by you, as long as King Bṛhadbala lived. / Whosoever became king in the country of Ānarta, he granted (8)

5.125.s:
sarvāṃ vṛttiṃ gṛhasthānāṃ yathāyogyaṃ prayatnataḥ ..
tavāgre kiṃ vayaṃ brūmastvaṃ vetsi sakalaṃ yataḥ .. 9 ..
5.125.d:
सर्वां वृत्तिं गृहस्थानां यथायोग्यं प्रयत्नतः ..
तवाग्रे किं वयं ब्रूमस्त्वं वेत्सि सकलं यतः .. 9 ..
5.125.m: the entire livelihood to householders with effort, as was proper. / What shall we say before you? For you know everything. (9)

5.125.s:
yathā vṛttiḥ purā dattā yathā saṃrakṣitā tvayā ..
tasmāccintaya rājendra sthānaṃ vartanasaṃbhavam ..
upāyaṃ yena maryādā vṛttistasmātsukhena tu .. 6.126.10 ..
5.125.d:
यथा वृत्तिः पुरा दत्ता यथा संरक्षिता त्वया ..
तस्माच्चिन्तय राजेन्द्र स्थानं वर्तनसंभवम् ..
उपायं येन मर्यादा वृत्तिस्तस्मात्सुखेन तु .. 6.126.10 ..
5.125.m: Just as the livelihood was granted of old and protected by you, / therefore, O lord of kings, devise an arrangement regarding the settlement of our livelihood, / a means by which order and livelihood may continue in comfort." (10)

5.125.s:
tataḥ sa suciraṃ dhyātvā gartātīrthasamudbhavān ..
ākāryopamanyuvaṃśasya saṃbhavānvedapāragān .. 11 ..
5.125.d:
ततः स सुचिरं ध्यात्वा गर्तातीर्थसमुद्भवान् ..
आकार्योपमन्युवंशस्य संभवान्वेदपारगान् .. 11 ..
5.125.m: Then, having reflected for a very long time, he summoned those born at Gartātīrtha, / born in the lineage of Upamanyu, who had mastered the Vedas. (11)

5.125.s:
praṇipātaṃ prakṛtvātha tataḥ provāca sādaram ..
madīyasthāna saṃsthānāṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ viśeṣataḥ .. 12 ..
5.125.d:
प्रणिपातं प्रकृत्वाथ ततः प्रोवाच सादरम् ..
मदीयस्थान संस्थानां ब्राह्मणानां विशेषतः .. 12 ..
5.125.m: Then, having bowed down, he spoke respectfully: / "To the brahmins residing especially in my settlement, (12)

5.125.s:
sarvakṛtyāni kāryāṇi bhṛtyavadvinayānvitaiḥ ..
nityaṃ rakṣā vidhātavyā yuṣmadīyaṃ vacokhilam .. 13 ..
5.125.d:
सर्वकृत्यानि कार्याणि भृत्यवद्विनयान्वितैः ..
नित्यं रक्षा विधातव्या युष्मदीयं वचोखिलम् .. 13 ..
5.125.m: all services must be performed by you, endowed with modesty like servants; / protection must be given constantly; and your every word [is to be observed]. (13)

5.125.s:
ete saṃpālayiṣyanti maryādākāramuttamam ..
sandeheṣu ca sarveṣu vivādeṣu viśeṣataḥ .. 14 ..
5.125.d:
एते संपालयिष्यन्ति मर्यादाकारमुत्तमम् ..
सन्देहेषु च सर्वेषु विवादेषु विशेषतः .. 14 ..
5.125.m: These will maintain the excellent standard of conduct, / in all doubts and especially in disputes. (14)

5.125.s:
rājakāryeṣu cānyeṣu ete dāsyanti nirṇayam ..
yuṣmadīyaṃ vacaḥ śrutvā śubhaṃ vā yadi vā'śubham .. 15 ..
5.125.d:
राजकार्येषु चान्येषु एते दास्यन्ति निर्णयम् ..
युष्मदीयं वचः श्रुत्वा शुभं वा यदि वाऽशुभम् .. 15 ..
5.125.m: And in other royal business, these will give the decision / after hearing your word, whether auspicious or inauspicious. (15)

5.125.s:
ete pālyāḥ prasādena puṣṭiṃ neyāśca śaktitaḥ..
īrṣyāṃ sarvāṃ parityajya madīyasthānavṛddhaye .. 16 ..
5.125.d:
एते पाल्याः प्रसादेन पुष्टिं नेयाश्च शक्तितः..
ईर्ष्यां सर्वां परित्यज्य मदीयस्थानवृद्धये .. 16 ..
5.125.m: These are to be maintained with favor and brought to prosperity according to ability, / abandoning all envy, for the growth of my settlement." (16)

5.125.s:
bāḍhamityeva taiḥ proktaḥ sa rājā brāhmaṇottamān ..
camatkāpurodbhūtānbhūyaḥ provāca sādaram .. 17 ..
5.125.d:
बाढमित्येव तैः प्रोक्तः स राजा ब्राह्मणोत्तमान् ..
चमत्कापुरोद्भूतान्भूयः प्रोवाच सादरम् .. 17 ..
5.125.m: Having been answered "So be it!" by them, the king / again respectfully addressed the best of brahmins born in Camatkārapura: (17)

5.125.s:
yuṣmākaṃ vartanārthāya sarvakṛtyeṣu sarvadā ..
ete viprā mayā dattā gartātīrthasamudbhavāḥ .. 18 ..
5.125.d:
युष्माकं वर्तनार्थाय सर्वकृत्येषु सर्वदा ..
एते विप्रा मया दत्ता गर्तातीर्थसमुद्भवाः .. 18 ..
5.125.m: "For the sake of your livelihood in all matters, at all times, / these brahmins born at Gartātīrtha have been given by me. (18)

5.125.s:
eteṣāṃ vacanātsarvaṃ yuṣmadīyaṃ prajāyatām ..
pratiṣṭhā jāyate nūnaṃ cātuścaraṇasūcitā .. 19 ..
5.125.d:
एतेषां वचनात्सर्वं युष्मदीयं प्रजायताम् ..
प्रतिष्ठा जायते नूनं चातुश्चरणसूचिता .. 19 ..
5.125.m: Let everything of yours be established according to their word; / indeed, prestige is established when indicated by the four quarters. (19)

5.125.s:
nānyathā brāhmaṇaśreṣṭhāḥ svalpaṃ vā yadi vā bahu ..
proktaṃ lakṣamitairanyairyuṣmadīyapurodbhavaiḥ .. 6.126.20 ..
5.125.d:
नान्यथा ब्राह्मणश्रेष्ठाः स्वल्पं वा यदि वा बहु ..
प्रोक्तं लक्षमितैरन्यैर्युष्मदीयपुरोद्भवैः .. 6.126.20 ..
5.125.m: It is not otherwise, O best of brahmins, whether little or much / is spoken by the other hundred thousand born in your city." (20)

5.125.s:
.. sūta uvāca ..
tataste brāhmaṇā hṛṣṭāstānādāya dvijottamān ..
teṣāṃ matena cakruśca sarvakṛtyāni sarvadā .. 21 ..
5.125.d:
.. सूत उवाच ..
ततस्ते ब्राह्मणा हृष्टास्तानादाय द्विजोत्तमान् ..
तेषां मतेन चक्रुश्च सर्वकृत्यानि सर्वदा .. 21 ..
5.125.m: Sūta said: / Then those delighted brahmins, taking those best of the twice-born, / carried out all tasks at all times according to their counsel. (21)

5.125.s:
tatastatra pure jātā maryādā dharmavarddhinī ..
sarvakṛtyeṣu sarveṣāṃ tathā vṛddhiḥ purasya ca .. 22 ..
5.125.d:
ततस्तत्र पुरे जाता मर्यादा धर्मवर्द्धिनी ..
सर्वकृत्येषु सर्वेषां तथा वृद्धिः पुरस्य च .. 22 ..
5.125.m: Then, in that city, proper conduct promoting righteousness was established / for everyone in all matters, as was the growth of the city. (22)

5.125.s:
te'pi teṣāṃ prasādena garttātīrthabhavā dvijāḥ ..
parāṃ vibhūtimāsthāya modante sukhasaṃyutāḥ .. 23 ..
5.125.d:
तेऽपि तेषां प्रसादेन गर्त्तातीर्थभवा द्विजाः ..
परां विभूतिमास्थाय मोदन्ते सुखसंयुताः .. 23 ..
5.125.m: Those brahmins born at Gartātīrtha, by their grace, / attained supreme prosperity and rejoiced, endowed with happiness.

5.125.s:
kasyacittvatha kālasya sa rājā tatpurottamam ..
samabhyetya dvijānsarvāṃstataḥ provāca sādaram ..24..
5.125.d:
कस्यचित्त्वथ कालस्य स राजा तत्पुरोत्तमम् ..
समभ्येत्य द्विजान्सर्वांस्ततः प्रोवाच सादरम् ..24..
5.125.m: Then, after some time, the king came to that excellent city, / and having approached all the brahmins, respectfully said:

5.125.s:
yuṣmadīyaprasādena kṣetre'tra sumahattapaḥ ..
kṛtaṃ svargaṃ prayāsyāmi sāṃprataṃ tu dvijottamāḥ .. 25 ..
5.125.d:
युष्मदीयप्रसादेन क्षेत्रेऽत्र सुमहत्तपः ..
कृतं स्वर्गं प्रयास्यामि सांप्रतं तु द्विजोत्तमाः .. 25 ..
5.125.m: “By your grace, great austerity has been performed in this sacred field. / I shall now go to heaven, O best of brahmins.

5.125.s:
nāsmākamanvaye kaścitsāṃprataṃ vartate nṛpaḥ ..
tasyāhaṃ liṃgametadvai darśayāmi dvijottamāḥ ..26..
5.125.d:
नास्माकमन्वये कश्चित्सांप्रतं वर्तते नृपः ..
तस्याहं लिंगमेतद्वै दर्शयामि द्विजोत्तमाः ..26..
5.125.m: There is no king now present in our lineage; / therefore, O best of brahmins, I show this liṅga to you,

5.125.s:
pūjārthaṃ cāpi vṛttyarthaṃ bhogārthaṃ ca viśeṣataḥ ..
tasmādyuṣmābhirevāsya pūjā kāryā prayatnataḥ ..
rathayātrā viśeṣeṇa dayāṃ kṛtvā mamopari .. 27 ..
5.125.d:
पूजार्थं चापि वृत्त्यर्थं भोगार्थं च विशेषतः ..
तस्माद्युष्माभिरेवास्य पूजा कार्या प्रयत्नतः ..
रथयात्रा विशेषेण दयां कृत्वा ममोपरि .. 27 ..
5.125.m: both for worship and for sustenance, and especially for enjoyments. / Therefore its worship should be performed diligently by you alone, / especially the chariot festival, having taken pity upon me.”

5.125.s:
.. brāhmaṇā ūcuḥ .. ..
sapta viṃśatiliṃgāni yatheṣṭāni mahītale ..
camatkārasutānāṃ ca pūjyaṃte sarvadaiva tu .. 28 ..
5.125.d:
.. ब्राह्मणा ऊचुः .. ..
सप्त विंशतिलिंगानि यथेष्टानि महीतले ..
चमत्कारसुतानां च पूज्यंते सर्वदैव तु .. 28 ..
5.125.m: The brahmins said: / “Twenty-seven liṅgas according to desire are upon the earth, / and are constantly worshipped by the sons of Camatkāra.

5.125.s:
aṣṭāviṃśatimaṃ tadvadetalliṃgaṃ tavodbhavam ..
sarvadā pūjayiṣyāmo niścinto bhava pārthiva .. 29 ..
5.125.d:
अष्टाविंशतिमं तद्वदेतल्लिंगं तवोद्भवम् ..
सर्वदा पूजयिष्यामो निश्चिन्तो भव पार्थिव .. 29 ..
5.125.m: Just so, as the twenty-eighth, we shall always worship / this liṅga sprung from you. Be free from worry, O king!

5.125.s:
asya yātrāṃ kariṣyāmaḥ kārtike māsi sarvadā ..
balipūjopahārāṃśca gītavādyāni śaktitaḥ .. 6.126.30 ..
5.125.d:
अस्य यात्रां करिष्यामः कार्तिके मासि सर्वदा ..
बलिपूजोपहारांश्च गीतवाद्यानि शक्तितः .. 6.126.30 ..
5.125.m: We shall always perform its festival in the month of Kārtika, / with offerings of oblation and worship, and songs and instrumental music according to our ability.”

5.125.s:
evamuktaḥ sa tairhṛṣṭo gatvātmīyaṃ tadāśramam ..
snāpayitvātha talliṃgaṃ pūjāṃ cakre prabhaktitaḥ .. 31 ..
5.125.d:
एवमुक्तः स तैर्हृष्टो गत्वात्मीयं तदाश्रमम् ..
स्नापयित्वाथ तल्लिंगं पूजां चक्रे प्रभक्तितः .. 31 ..
5.125.m: Thus addressed, delighted by them, he went to his hermitage, / and having bathed that liṅga, he performed worship with great devotion.

5.125.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
evaṃ samarpitaṃ liṃgaṃ tena taddharasaṃbhavam ..
sarveṣāṃ brāhmaṇeṃdrāṇāṃ vaṃśocchede sthite dvijāḥ .. 32 ..
5.125.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
एवं समर्पितं लिंगं तेन तद्धरसंभवम् ..
सर्वेषां ब्राह्मणेंद्राणां वंशोच्छेदे स्थिते द्विजाः .. 32 ..
5.125.m: Sūta said: / Thus that liṅga born of Hara was entrusted by him / to all the eminent brahmins, O brahmins, since the destruction of his lineage was at hand.

5.125.s:
sakalaṃ kārtikaṃ martyo yastacchraddhāsamanvitaḥ ..
snāpayetpūjayeccāpi sa nūnaṃ muktimāpnuyāt .. 33 ..
5.125.d:
सकलं कार्तिकं मर्त्यो यस्तच्छ्रद्धासमन्वितः ..
स्नापयेत्पूजयेच्चापि स नूनं मुक्तिमाप्नुयात् .. 33 ..
5.125.m: Whatever mortal, endowed with faith, bathes and worships it / during the entire month of Kārtika, surely attains liberation.

5.125.s:
somasya divase prāpte varṣaṃ yāvatkṛtakṣaṇaḥ ..
tasya pūjāṃ karotyevaṃ snāpayitvā vidhānataḥ ..
so'pi muktiṃ vrajenmartya etattātānmayā śrutam .. 34 ..
5.125.d:
सोमस्य दिवसे प्राप्ते वर्षं यावत्कृतक्षणः ..
तस्य पूजां करोत्येवं स्नापयित्वा विधानतः ..
सोऽपि मुक्तिं व्रजेन्मर्त्य एतत्तातान्मया श्रुतम् .. 34 ..
5.125.m: When the day of Soma arrives, one who seizes the opportunity for a year, / and thus performs its worship after bathing it according to the rule, / that mortal too goes to liberation: this was heard by me from my father.

5.125.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe hāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye satyasaṃdheśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma ṣaḍviṃśatyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 126 .. .. cha ..
5.125.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां षष्ठे नागरखण्डे हाटकेश्वरक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये सत्यसंधेश्वरमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम षड्विंशत्यधिकशततमोऽध्यायः .. 126 .. .. छ ..
5.125.m: Thus ends the one hundred and twenty-sixth chapter, named 'Description of the Māhātmya of Satyasaṃdheśvara', in the Māhātmya of Hāṭakeśvarakṣetra in the Nāgarakhaṇḍa, the sixth [part] of the Skanda Mahāpurāṇa consisting of eighty-one thousand verses.

5.126.s:
.. ṛṣaya ūcuḥ .. ..
yā sā karṇotpalānāma tvayāsmākaṃ prakīrtitā ..
kiñcijjalāśrayaṃ prāpya tapastapati saṃsthitā ..
tasyāḥ sarvaṃ samācakṣva yathā tapasi sā sthitā .. 1 ..
5.126.d:
.. ऋषय ऊचुः .. ..
या सा कर्णोत्पलानाम त्वयास्माकं प्रकीर्तिता ..
किञ्चिज्जलाश्रयं प्राप्य तपस्तपति संस्थिता ..
तस्याः सर्वं समाचक्ष्व यथा तपसि सा स्थिता .. 1 ..
5.126.m: The seers said: / She who was praised to us by you, named Karṇotpalā, / who stayed practicing austerity after reaching a small water reservoir, / tell everything about her, how she remained in austerity.

5.126.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
gaurīpādakṛtasthānā śraddhayā parayā yutā ..
tāvattuṣṭiṃ gatā devī girijā śaṃkarapriyā .. 2 ..
5.126.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
गौरीपादकृतस्थाना श्रद्धया परया युता ..
तावत्तुष्टिं गता देवी गिरिजा शंकरप्रिया .. 2 ..
5.126.m: Sūta said: / Having taken her place at the feet of Gaurī, endowed with supreme faith, / for so long, the goddess, the daughter of the mountain, the beloved of Śaṃkara, became pleased.

5.126.s:
tataḥ provāca te putri tuṣṭāhaṃ vāṃchitaṃ vada ..
yena yacchāmyasaṃdigdhaṃ yadyapi syātsudurlabham .. 3 ..
5.126.d:
ततः प्रोवाच ते पुत्रि तुष्टाहं वांछितं वद ..
येन यच्छाम्यसंदिग्धं यद्यपि स्यात्सुदुर्लभम् .. 3 ..
5.126.m: Then she said: “O daughter, I am pleased! State your desire, / so that I may grant it without doubt, even if it is very difficult to obtain.”

5.126.s:
.. karṇotpalovāca .. ..
mama patyuḥ kṛte devi mama tātaḥ suduḥkhitaḥ ..
rājyādbhraṣṭaḥ sukhāccāpi kuṭuṃbena vivarjitaḥ .. 4 .
5.126.d:
.. कर्णोत्पलोवाच .. ..
मम पत्युः कृते देवि मम तातः सुदुःखितः ..
राज्याद्भ्रष्टः सुखाच्चापि कुटुंबेन विवर्जितः .. 4 .
5.126.m: Karṇotpalā said: / “O goddess, for the sake of a husband for me, my father is deeply grieving; / he has fallen from kingship and from happiness, and is deserted by his family.

5.126.s:
tataścaiva tapastepe vairāgyaṃ paramaṃ gataḥ ..
ahaṃ vārddhakyamāpannā kaumārye'pi ca saṃsthitā .. 5 ..
5.126.d:
ततश्चैव तपस्तेपे वैराग्यं परमं गतः ..
अहं वार्द्धक्यमापन्ना कौमार्येऽपि च संस्थिता .. 5 ..
5.126.m: Therefore he practiced austerity, having attained supreme detachment; / and I have reached old age while still remaining in virginity.

5.126.s:
tasmādbhavatu me bharttā kaścidrūpotkaṭaḥ smṛtaḥ ..
sarveṣāṃ devamartyānāṃ tvatprasādātsureśvari ..6..
5.126.d:
तस्माद्भवतु मे भर्त्ता कश्चिद्रूपोत्कटः स्मृतः ..
सर्वेषां देवमर्त्यानां त्वत्प्रसादात्सुरेश्वरि ..6..
5.126.m: Therefore, by your grace, O ruler of the gods, may someone known / for eminent beauty among all gods and mortals become my husband!

5.126.s:
tathā syātparamaṃ rūpaṃ tāruṇyaṃ tvatprasādataḥ ..
yathāsya jāyate saukhyaṃ tāpasasyāpi me pituḥ .. 7 ..
5.126.d:
तथा स्यात्परमं रूपं तारुण्यं त्वत्प्रसादतः ..
यथास्य जायते सौख्यं तापसस्यापि मे पितुः .. 7 ..
5.126.m: And likewise, by your grace, may there be supreme beauty and youth [for me], / so that happiness may arise for this ascetic father of mine.”

5.126.s:
.. devyuvāca .. ..
māghamāsatṛtīyāyāṃ śanaiścaradine śubhe ..
nakṣatre vasudaivatye rūpaṃ dhyātvātha yauvanam .. 8 ..
5.126.d:
.. देव्युवाच .. ..
माघमासतृतीयायां शनैश्चरदिने शुभे ..
नक्षत्रे वसुदैवत्ये रूपं ध्यात्वाथ यौवनम् .. 8 ..
5.126.m: The goddess said: / “On the third lunar day of the month of Māgha, on an auspicious Saturday, / under the lunar mansion whose deity is the Vasus, having meditated on beauty and youth,

5.126.s:
tvayā snānaṃ prakartavyaṃ supuṇye'tra jalāśaye ..
tato divya vapurbhūtvā yauvanena samanvitā.
bhaviṣyasi na saṃdehaḥ satyametanmayoditam .. 9 ..
5.126.d:
त्वया स्नानं प्रकर्तव्यं सुपुण्येऽत्र जलाशये ..
ततो दिव्य वपुर्भूत्वा यौवनेन समन्विता.
भविष्यसि न संदेहः सत्यमेतन्मयोदितम् .. 9 ..
5.126.m: a ritual ablution must be performed by you in this very holy reservoir of water. / Then, having assumed a celestial body endowed with youth, / you will become [so], there is no doubt; this spoken by me is true.

5.126.s:
anyāpi yā mahābhāge nārī snānaṃ kariṣyati..
tasminnahani sāpyevaṃ rūpayuktā bhaviṣyati .. 6.127.10. ..
..sūta uvāca.. ..
evamuktvātha sā devī gatā cādarśanaṃ tataḥ ..
sāpi cānveṣayāmāsa tṛtīyāṃ śaninā saha .. 11 ..
5.126.d:
अन्यापि या महाभागे नारी स्नानं करिष्यति..
तस्मिन्नहनि साप्येवं रूपयुक्ता भविष्यति .. 6.127.10. ..
..सूत उवाच.. ..
एवमुक्त्वाथ सा देवी गता चादर्शनं ततः ..
सापि चान्वेषयामास तृतीयां शनिना सह .. 11 ..
5.126.m: Any other woman, O highly fortunate one, who performs a ritual ablution / on that day, will likewise become endowed with beauty.” / Sūta said: / Having spoken thus, that goddess then disappeared from sight; / and she also sought out the third lunar day falling on a Saturday,

5.126.s:
vasudevātmakenaiva nakṣatreṇa prayatnataḥ ..
dhyāyamānā ca tāṃ devīṃ sarvakāmapradāyinīm .. 12 ..
5.126.d:
वसुदेवात्मकेनैव नक्षत्रेण प्रयत्नतः ..
ध्यायमाना च तां देवीं सर्वकामप्रदायिनीम् .. 12 ..
5.126.m: diligently [awaiting] the lunar mansion belonging to the deity of the Vasus, / and meditating on that goddess who grants all desires.

5.126.s:
tataḥ katipayāhasya jātā sā yogasaṃyutā ..
tṛtīyā yā yathoktā ca tayā devyā purā dvijāḥ .. 13 ..
5.126.d:
ततः कतिपयाहस्य जाता सा योगसंयुता ..
तृतीया या यथोक्ता च तया देव्या पुरा द्विजाः .. 13 ..
5.126.m: Then, after a few days, that third lunar day arrived, endowed with the conjunction / as described previously by that goddess, O brahmins.

5.126.s:
tataḥ sā rūpasaubhāgyaṃ yauvanaṃ vāṃchitaṃ patim ..
dhyāyamānā jale tasminnarddharātre viveśa ca .. 14 ..
5.126.d:
ततः सा रूपसौभाग्यं यौवनं वांछितं पतिम् ..
ध्यायमाना जले तस्मिन्नर्द्धरात्रे विवेश च .. 14 ..
5.126.m: Then, meditating on beauty, auspicious fortune, youth, and the desired husband, / she entered that water at midnight.

5.126.s:
tato divyavapurbhūtvā yauvanena samanvitā ..
niṣkrāṃtā salilāttasmājjanavismayakāriṇī .. 15 ..
5.126.d:
ततो दिव्यवपुर्भूत्वा यौवनेन समन्विता ..
निष्क्रांता सलिलात्तस्माज्जनविस्मयकारिणी .. 15 ..
5.126.m: Then, having assumed a celestial body, endowed with youth, / she emerged from that water, causing astonishment among the people.

5.126.s:
etasminnaṃtare prāpto gaurīvākyaprabodhitaḥ ..
tadarthaṃ bhagavānkāmaḥ patnyarthaṃ prītisaṃyutaḥ ..
abravīcca mahābhāge kāmohaṃ svayamāgataḥ .. 16 ..
5.126.d:
एतस्मिन्नंतरे प्राप्तो गौरीवाक्यप्रबोधितः ..
तदर्थं भगवान्कामः पत्न्यर्थं प्रीतिसंयुतः ..
अब्रवीच्च महाभागे कामोहं स्वयमागतः .. 16 ..
5.126.m: In the meantime, awakened by the word of Gaurī, / the blessed Kāma arrived for that purpose, longing for a wife, filled with love; / and he said: “O highly fortunate one, I am Kāma, come in person.

5.126.s: pārvatyādeśitā bhāryā tasmānme bhava mā ciram .. .. 17 ..
5.126.d: पार्वत्यादेशिता भार्या तस्मान्मे भव मा चिरम् .. .. 17 ..
5.126.m: You were designated as my wife by Pārvatī; therefore become mine without delay!

5.126.s:
yasmātprītyā samāyātastavāṃtikamahaṃ śubhe ..
tasmātprītiriti khyātā mama bhāryā bhaviṣyasi .. 18 ..
5.126.d:
यस्मात्प्रीत्या समायातस्तवांतिकमहं शुभे ..
तस्मात्प्रीतिरिति ख्याता मम भार्या भविष्यसि .. 18 ..
5.126.m: Since I have come to your presence out of affection, O auspicious one, / therefore, known as Prīti, you shall become my wife.”

5.126.s:
.. karṇotpalovāca .. ..
yadyevaṃ smara mattātaṃ taṃ gatvā prārthaya svayam ..
svacchaṃdā syādyataḥ kanyā na kathaṃcitpravartitā .. 19 ..
5.126.d:
.. कर्णोत्पलोवाच .. ..
यद्येवं स्मर मत्तातं तं गत्वा प्रार्थय स्वयम् ..
स्वच्छंदा स्याद्यतः कन्या न कथंचित्प्रवर्तिता .. 19 ..
5.126.m: Karṇotpalā said: / “If it is so, O Smara, go yourself and ask my father, / since a maiden should never proceed according to her own will.

5.126.s:
ya eṣa dṛśyate ramyaḥ prāsādo nāti dūrataḥ ..
asyāṃte tiṣṭhate'smākaṃ tātastapasi saṃsthitaḥ .. 6.127.20 ..
5.126.d:
य एष दृश्यते रम्यः प्रासादो नाति दूरतः ..
अस्यांते तिष्ठतेऽस्माकं तातस्तपसि संस्थितः .. 6.127.20 ..
5.126.m: This charming temple which is seen not very far away— / beside it our father remains, engaged in austerity.

5.126.s:
atrāhaṃ pūrvato gatvā tasya tiṣṭhāmi cāṃtike ..
bhavānāgatya paścācca prārthayiṣyati māṃ tataḥ .. 21 ..
5.126.d:
अत्राहं पूर्वतो गत्वा तस्य तिष्ठामि चांतिके ..
भवानागत्य पश्चाच्च प्रार्थयिष्यति मां ततः .. 21 ..
5.126.m: Having gone there first, I shall stand near him; / and having come afterwards, you may then ask for me.”

5.126.s:
bāḍhamityeva kāmokte gatā sā tatsamīpataḥ ..
praṇipatya tataḥ prāha diṣṭyā tāta mayā punaḥ .. 22 ..
5.126.d:
बाढमित्येव कामोक्ते गता सा तत्समीपतः ..
प्रणिपत्य ततः प्राह दिष्ट्या तात मया पुनः .. 22 ..
5.126.m: When Kāma said, “Very well,” she went near him, / and having bowed down, she then said: “Fortunately, O father, once again

5.126.s:
saṃprāptaṃ yauvanaṃ kāṃtaṃ samārādhya harapriyām ..
tasmātkuru vivāhaṃ me hṛtsthaṃ sukhamavāpnuhi .. 23 ..
5.126.d:
संप्राप्तं यौवनं कांतं समाराध्य हरप्रियाम् ..
तस्मात्कुरु विवाहं मे हृत्स्थं सुखमवाप्नुहि .. 23 ..
5.126.m: lovely youth has been attained by me, having propitiated the beloved of Hara. / Therefore arrange my marriage, and obtain the happiness dwelling in your heart!

5.126.s:
madarthe preṣito bharttā tayā devyā'tisundaraḥ ..
puṣpa cāpaḥ svayaṃ prāptaḥ so'pi tāta tavāṃtikam .. 24 ..
5.126.d:
मदर्थे प्रेषितो भर्त्ता तया देव्याऽतिसुन्दरः ..
पुष्प चापः स्वयं प्राप्तः सोऽपि तात तवांतिकम् .. 24 ..
5.126.m: A most handsome husband was sent by that goddess for my sake; / he whose bow is flowers has himself arrived into your presence, O father.”

5.126.s:
atha tāṃ sa samālokya svāṃ sutāṃ yauvanānvitām ..
harṣeṇa mahatā yuktāṃ kāṃtayuktāṃ viśeṣataḥ ..
abravīdadya me putri saṃjātaṃ tapasaḥ phalam .. 25 ..
5.126.d:
अथ तां स समालोक्य स्वां सुतां यौवनान्विताम् ..
हर्षेण महता युक्तां कांतयुक्तां विशेषतः ..
अब्रवीदद्य मे पुत्रि संजातं तपसः फलम् .. 25 ..
5.126.m: Then, beholding his own daughter endowed with youth, / filled with great joy and especially endowed with radiance, / he said: “Today, O daughter, the fruit of austerity has been born for me,

5.126.s:
jīvitasya ca kalyāṇi yatvaṃ prāptā navaṃ vayaḥ ..
bhartāraṃ ca tathābhīṣṭaṃ devyā dattaṃ manobhavam .. 26 ..
5.126.d:
जीवितस्य च कल्याणि यत्वं प्राप्ता नवं वयः ..
भर्तारं च तथाभीष्टं देव्या दत्तं मनोभवम् .. 26 ..
5.126.m: and [the fruit] of life, O auspicious one, since you have obtained fresh youth, / and likewise a desired husband, Manobhava, given by the goddess.”

5.126.s:
etasminnaṃtare kāmastasyāṃtikamupādravat ..
abravīddehi me bhūpa svāṃ kanyāṃ cāruhāsinīm .. 27 ..
5.126.d:
एतस्मिन्नंतरे कामस्तस्यांतिकमुपाद्रवत् ..
अब्रवीद्देहि मे भूप स्वां कन्यां चारुहासिनीम् .. 27 ..
5.126.m: At that moment Kāma came running near her. / He said: 'O king, give me your daughter of sweet smiles!

5.126.s:
asyā arthe'hamādiṣṭaḥ svayaṃ gauryā nṛpottama ..
kāmadeva iti khyātastrailokyaṃ yena mohitam .. 28 ..
5.126.d:
अस्या अर्थेऽहमादिष्टः स्वयं गौर्या नृपोत्तम ..
कामदेव इति ख्यातस्त्रैलोक्यं येन मोहितम् .. 28 ..
5.126.m: For her sake I have been commanded by Gaurī herself, O best of kings; / I am known as Kāmadeva, by whom the three worlds are enchanted.'

5.126.s:
tatastāmarpayāmāsa tāṃ kanyāṃ sa mahīpatiḥ ..
kṛtvāgniṃ sākṣiṇaṃ vākyādbrāhmaṇānāṃ dvijottamāḥ .. 29 ..
5.126.d:
ततस्तामर्पयामास तां कन्यां स महीपतिः ..
कृत्वाग्निं साक्षिणं वाक्याद्ब्राह्मणानां द्विजोत्तमाः .. 29 ..
5.126.m: Then that ruler of the earth gave away that maiden, / having made fire his witness at the word of the brahmins, O best of the twice-born.

5.126.s:
sā cāsya cābhavatprītisthānaṃ yasmātsulocanā ..
rateranaṃtarā tasmātprītināmā'bhavacchubhā .. 6.127.30 ..
5.126.d:
सा चास्य चाभवत्प्रीतिस्थानं यस्मात्सुलोचना ..
रतेरनंतरा तस्मात्प्रीतिनामाऽभवच्छुभा .. 6.127.30 ..
5.126.m: And she, fair-eyed, became the source of pleasure (prīti) to him; / therefore, next to Rati, she became the auspicious one named Prīti.

5.126.s:
evaṃ tayā tapastaptaṃ tasmāttatra jalāśaye ..
tannāmnā khyātimāyātaṃ samaste'tra mahītale .. 31 ..
5.126.d:
एवं तया तपस्तप्तं तस्मात्तत्र जलाशये ..
तन्नाम्ना ख्यातिमायातं समस्तेऽत्र महीतले .. 31 ..
5.126.m: Thus austerity was performed by her there in that reservoir of water; / therefore it has attained renown by her name everywhere on this earth.

5.126.s:
sakalaṃ māghamāsaṃ ca yā strī snānaṃ samācaret ..
pumānvā prātarutthāya sa prayāgaphalaṃ labhet .. 32 ..
5.126.d:
सकलं माघमासं च या स्त्री स्नानं समाचरेत् ..
पुमान्वा प्रातरुत्थाय स प्रयागफलं लभेत् .. 32 ..
5.126.m: Whatever woman or man, having risen in the morning, / performs ritual ablution during the entire month of Māgha, obtains the fruit of Prayāga.

5.126.s:
rūpavāñjāyate dakṣaḥ sadā janmani janmani ..
na viyogamavāpnoti kadātridbāṃdhavaiḥ saha .. 33 ..
5.126.d:
रूपवाञ्जायते दक्षः सदा जन्मनि जन्मनि ..
न वियोगमवाप्नोति कदात्रिद्बांधवैः सह .. 33 ..
5.126.m: He is born handsome and capable always in birth after birth; / he never suffers separation from his kinsmen.

5.126.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe hāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye karṇotpalātīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma saptaviṃśatyuttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 127 .. ..
5.126.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां षष्ठे नागरखण्डे हाटकेश्वरक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये कर्णोत्पलातीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनं नाम सप्तविंशत्युत्तरशततमोऽध्यायः .. 127 .. ..
5.126.m: Thus ends the hundred and twenty-seventh chapter, entitled 'Description of the Māhātmya of Karṇotpalātīrtha', in the Māhātmya of the Hāṭakeśvarakṣetra, in the Nāgarakhaṇḍa, the sixth [part] of the auspicious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa consisting of eighty-one thousand verses.

5.127.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
satyasandhopi hṛṣṭātmā satāṃ dṛṣṭvā sukhānvitām..
abhīṣṭapatinā yuktāṃ kṛtakṛtyo babhūva ha .. 1 ..
5.127.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
सत्यसन्धोपि हृष्टात्मा सतां दृष्ट्वा सुखान्विताम्..
अभीष्टपतिना युक्तां कृतकृत्यो बभूव ह .. 1 ..
5.127.m: Sūta said: / Satyasandha, too, glad at heart upon seeing that virtuous girl endowed with happiness / and united with a cherished husband, felt his purpose accomplished.

5.127.s:
tatastasyaiva liṃgasya dakṣiṇāṃ mūrtimāśritaḥ ..
dṛḍhaṃ padmāsanaṃ kṛtvā samyagdhyānaparāyaṇaḥ .. 2 ..
5.127.d:
ततस्तस्यैव लिंगस्य दक्षिणां मूर्तिमाश्रितः ..
दृढं पद्मासनं कृत्वा सम्यग्ध्यानपरायणः .. 2 ..
5.127.m: Then, having resorted to the southern form of that very liṅga, / assuming a firm lotus posture and fully intent on meditation,

5.127.s:
ātmānamātmanaivātha brahmadvāreṇa saṃsthitaḥ ..
tato niḥsārayāmāsa pulakena samanvitaḥ .. 3 ..
5.127.d:
आत्मानमात्मनैवाथ ब्रह्मद्वारेण संस्थितः ..
ततो निःसारयामास पुलकेन समन्वितः .. 3 ..
5.127.m: stationed there, through the brahminical aperture (brahmadvāra), / he then released the self by the self, filled with horripilation.

5.127.s:
atha te brāhmaṇāstasya camatkārapurodbhavāḥ ..
devatā darśanārthāya prāptā dṛṣṭvā kalevaram .. 4 ..
5.127.d:
अथ ते ब्राह्मणास्तस्य चमत्कारपुरोद्भवाः ..
देवता दर्शनार्थाय प्राप्ता दृष्ट्वा कलेवरम् .. 4 ..
5.127.m: Then those brahmins born in the city of Camatkāra, / who had arrived to see the deity, saw his body,

5.127.s:
apriyaṃ tejasā hīnaṃ mṛtamaspṛśyatāṃ gatam ..
liṃgasya nātidūrasthaṃ dāhyārthaṃ yatnamāsthitāḥ .. 5 ..
5.127.d:
अप्रियं तेजसा हीनं मृतमस्पृश्यतां गतम् ..
लिंगस्य नातिदूरस्थं दाह्यार्थं यत्नमास्थिताः .. 5 ..
5.127.m: unpleasant, bereft of luster, dead, having become untouchable, / standing not far from the liṅga, and undertook efforts to cremate it.

5.127.s:
yāvadgurvīṃ citāṃ kṛtvā tamanveṣṭuṃ samudyatāḥ ..
tāvannaṣṭaṃ śavaṃ tacca jñāyate naiva kutracit .. 6 ..
5.127.d:
यावद्गुर्वीं चितां कृत्वा तमन्वेष्टुं समुद्यताः ..
तावन्नष्टं शवं तच्च ज्ञायते नैव कुत्रचित् .. 6 ..
5.127.m: As soon as they had prepared a large funeral pyre and set about searching for him, / just then the corpse vanished, and was not found anywhere.

5.127.s:
tataśca vismayāviṣṭāstaṃ praśaṃsāsamanvitaiḥ ..
vacanairbahuśo bhūyo vikathya ca muhurmuhuḥ .. 7 ..
5.127.d:
ततश्च विस्मयाविष्टास्तं प्रशंसासमन्वितैः ..
वचनैर्बहुशो भूयो विकथ्य च मुहुर्मुहुः .. 7 ..
5.127.m: Then, seized with astonishment, having praised him repeatedly / with words full of praise, conversing again and again,

5.127.s:
tatastasyotthaliṃgasya sarvaṃ pūjādikaṃ ca yat ..
sarve nirūpayāmāsuḥ saptaviṃśatimadhyataḥ .. 8 ..
5.127.d:
ततस्तस्योत्थलिंगस्य सर्वं पूजादिकं च यत् ..
सर्वे निरूपयामासुः सप्तविंशतिमध्यतः .. 8 ..
5.127.m: they all settled all the worship and rituals for that liṅga which had arisen, / as one among the twenty-seven,

5.127.s:
liṃgānāṃ tadbhavennityaṃ satyasaṃdhasya bhūpateḥ ..
kāmadaṃ bhaktajaṃtūnāṃ sarvapātakanāśanam .. 9 ..
5.127.d:
लिंगानां तद्भवेन्नित्यं सत्यसंधस्य भूपतेः ..
कामदं भक्तजंतूनां सर्वपातकनाशनम् .. 9 ..
5.127.m: among the liṅgas of King Satyasandha, which grants desires / to devoted creatures and destroys all sins forever.

5.127.s:
.. ṛṣaya ūcuḥ .. ..
camatkāranareṃdrasya vaṃśe kṣīṇe mahāmate ..
ānarttādhipatiḥ ko'nyastatra rājā babhūva ha .. 6.128.10 ..
5.127.d:
.. ऋषय ऊचुः .. ..
चमत्कारनरेंद्रस्य वंशे क्षीणे महामते ..
आनर्त्ताधिपतिः कोऽन्यस्तत्र राजा बभूव ह .. 6.128.10 ..
5.127.m: The ṛṣis said: / When the lineage of King Camatkāra was extinguished, O wise one, / what other king then became the ruler of Ānarta?

5.127.s:
sūta uvāca .. ..
bṛhadbale hate bhūpe saṃgrāme dvijasattamāḥ .
putrabaṃdhusamāyuktāḥ sarva lokāḥ samāyayuḥ .. 11 ..
5.127.d:
सूत उवाच .. ..
बृहद्बले हते भूपे संग्रामे द्विजसत्तमाः .
पुत्रबंधुसमायुक्ताः सर्व लोकाः समाययुः .. 11 ..
5.127.m: Sūta said: / When King Bṛhadbala had been slain in battle, O best of the twice-born, / all the people, accompanied by sons and kinsmen, came together

5.127.s:
yatrasthaḥ sa mahīpālaḥ satyasaṃdhastaponvitaḥ ..
śokodvignāstataḥ prāhustaṃ bhūpaṃ rahasi sthitam .. 12 ..
5.127.d:
यत्रस्थः स महीपालः सत्यसंधस्तपोन्वितः ..
शोकोद्विग्नास्ततः प्राहुस्तं भूपं रहसि स्थितम् .. 12 ..
5.127.m: where that ruler of the earth, Satyasandha, endowed with austerity, was staying; / agitated with sorrow, they said to that king residing in solitude:

5.127.s:
kṣīṇo'yaṃ tāvako vaṃśo na kaścidvidyate yataḥ ..
dāyādo'pi kathaṃ pṛthvī saṃpratīyaṃ bhaviṣyati .. 13 ..
5.127.d:
क्षीणोऽयं तावको वंशो न कश्चिद्विद्यते यतः ..
दायादोऽपि कथं पृथ्वी संप्रतीयं भविष्यति .. 13 ..
5.127.m: 'This lineage of yours has perished, since there is no one left, / not even an heir; how will this earth be governed now?

5.127.s:
arājake nṛpaśreṣṭha mātsyo nyāyaḥ pravartate ..
rāṣṭre caiva pure caiva grāme caiva viśeṣataḥ .. 14 ..
5.127.d:
अराजके नृपश्रेष्ठ मात्स्यो न्यायः प्रवर्तते ..
राष्ट्रे चैव पुरे चैव ग्रामे चैव विशेषतः .. 14 ..
5.127.m: Where there is no king, O best of kings, the law of the fishes prevails, / particularly in the realm, in the city, and in the village.

5.127.s:
paradāraratā ye ca ye ca taskaravṛttayaḥ .
sarve rājabhayādrājanmaryādāṃ pālayaṃti vai .. 15 ..
5.127.d:
परदाररता ये च ये च तस्करवृत्तयः .
सर्वे राजभयाद्राजन्मर्यादां पालयंति वै .. 15 ..
5.127.m: Those devoted to other men's wives and those whose livelihood is theft, / all observe proper order solely out of fear of the king, O king.

5.127.s:
tasmāttvaṃ tapa utsṛjya rājyaṃ pūrvakramāgatam ..
kuru rājyaṃ tathā dārānputrārthaṃ prāpya mā ciram .. 16 ..
5.127.d:
तस्मात्त्वं तप उत्सृज्य राज्यं पूर्वक्रमागतम् ..
कुरु राज्यं तथा दारान्पुत्रार्थं प्राप्य मा चिरम् .. 16 ..
5.127.m: Therefore, renounce austerity, rule the kingdom that has come by ancestral succession, / and without delay take wives for the sake of sons!'

5.127.s:
.. rājovāca .. ..
saṃnyasto'haṃ dvijaśreṣṭhā na rājyaṃ kartumutsahe ..
na sutānāṃ na dārāṇāṃ saṃgrahaṃ ca kathaṃcana .. 17 ..
5.127.d:
.. राजोवाच .. ..
संन्यस्तोऽहं द्विजश्रेष्ठा न राज्यं कर्तुमुत्सहे ..
न सुतानां न दाराणां संग्रहं च कथंचन .. 17 ..
5.127.m: The king said: / 'I have renounced worldly life, O best of the twice-born; I do not wish to rule the kingdom, / nor do I wish to acquire wives or sons in any way.

5.127.s:
tatputrārthaṃ pravakṣyāmi yuṣmākaṃ svāminaḥ kṛte ..
upāyaṃ yena rājā syādānartto lokapālakaḥ .. 18 .
5.127.d:
तत्पुत्रार्थं प्रवक्ष्यामि युष्माकं स्वामिनः कृते ..
उपायं येन राजा स्यादानर्त्तो लोकपालकः .. 18 .
5.127.m: Therefore, for your sake, for the sake of a son for your master, I will explain / an expedient whereby there will be a king, a protector of the people in Ānarta.

5.127.s:
jāmadagnyena rāmeṇa yadā kṣatraṃ nipātitam ..
garbhasthamapi kārtsnyena kopopahatacetasā .. 19 ..
5.127.d:
जामदग्न्येन रामेण यदा क्षत्रं निपातितम् ..
गर्भस्थमपि कार्त्स्न्येन कोपोपहतचेतसा .. 19 ..
5.127.m: When the kṣatriya order was struck down by Rāma, son of Jamadagni, / even while in the womb, entirely, his mind overcome with anger,

5.127.s:
tataḥ kṣatriyabhāryāḥ prāgṛtusnānātsamāyayuḥ ..
brāhmaṇānputrajanmārthaṃ na kāmārthaṃ kathaṃcana .. 6.128.20 ..
5.127.d:
ततः क्षत्रियभार्याः प्रागृतुस्नानात्समाययुः ..
ब्राह्मणान्पुत्रजन्मार्थं न कामार्थं कथंचन .. 6.128.20 ..
5.127.m: the wives of the kṣatriyas, after their ritual post-menstrual ablutions, then approached / brahmins for the sake of bearing sons, not at all for lust.

5.127.s:
tataḥ putrāḥ samutpannāstejovīryasamanvitāḥ ..
kṣetrajā bhūmipālānāṃ saṃjātāśca mahīkṣitaḥ ..21..
5.127.d:
ततः पुत्राः समुत्पन्नास्तेजोवीर्यसमन्विताः ..
क्षेत्रजा भूमिपालानां संजाताश्च महीक्षितः ..21..
5.127.m: Then sons endowed with vigor and valor were born; / they became rulers of the earth, born of the fields (kṣetraja) of those kings.

5.127.s:
tasmādbṛhadbalasyaitā bhāryāstiṣṭhaṃti yā janāḥ ..
brāhmaṇāṃstā upāgamya ṛtusnātā yathocitān .. 22 ..
5.127.d:
तस्माद्बृहद्बलस्यैता भार्यास्तिष्ठंति या जनाः ..
ब्राह्मणांस्ता उपागम्य ऋतुस्नाता यथोचितान् .. 22 ..
5.127.m: Therefore, O people, let these wives of Bṛhadbala who remain / approach suitable brahmins after their post-menstrual ablutions.

5.127.s:
labhiṣyaṃti ca putrāṃstāstebhyaḥ kṣatriyapuṃgavān ..
ye bhūmiṃ pālayiṣyaṃti pālayiṣyaṃti ca prajāḥ .. 23 ..
5.127.d:
लभिष्यंति च पुत्रांस्तास्तेभ्यः क्षत्रियपुंगवान् ..
ये भूमिं पालयिष्यंति पालयिष्यंति च प्रजाः .. 23 ..
5.127.m: And from them they will obtain sons, bulls among kṣatriyas, / who will protect the earth and protect the subjects.

5.127.s:
tathā'trāsti śubhaṃ kuṇḍaṃ vāsiṣṭhaṃ putrajanmadam ..
yatra snātā ṛtau nārī sadyo garbhavatī bhavet ..
amogharetāḥ kāṃtā ca snānādatra prajāyate .. 24 ..
5.127.d:
तथाऽत्रास्ति शुभं कुण्डं वासिष्ठं पुत्रजन्मदम् ..
यत्र स्नाता ऋतौ नारी सद्यो गर्भवती भवेत् ..
अमोघरेताः कांता च स्नानादत्र प्रजायते .. 24 ..
5.127.m: Moreover, here is an auspicious pond sacred to Vasiṣṭha, which grants the birth of sons, / where a woman having bathed during her season immediately becomes pregnant; / and the beloved woman's conception becomes unfailing by bathing here.

5.127.s:
ye pūrvaṃ kṣatriyā jātā brāhmaṇaiḥ kṣatriṇīṣu ca ..
te sarve tatprabhāvena saṃjātā nātra saṃśayaḥ .. 25 ..
5.127.d:
ये पूर्वं क्षत्रिया जाता ब्राह्मणैः क्षत्रिणीषु च ..
ते सर्वे तत्प्रभावेन संजाता नात्र संशयः .. 25 ..
5.127.m: Those kṣatriyas who were previously born through brahmins from kṣatriya women, / were all born through its power; of this there is no doubt.

5.127.s:
yayāyayā dvijo yaśca kṣatriṇyā'bhūdvṛtaḥ purā ..
tayā saha samāgatya snātaṃ mantrapuraskṛtam .. 26 ..
5.127.d:
ययायया द्विजो यश्च क्षत्रिण्याऽभूद्वृतः पुरा ..
तया सह समागत्य स्नातं मन्त्रपुरस्कृतम् .. 26 ..
5.127.m: Whichever brahmin was formerly chosen by whichever kṣatriya woman, / having come together with her, bathed with recitation of mantras;

5.127.s:
sakṛnmaidhunasaṃsargāttatastīrthaprabhāvataḥ ..
sarvāsāṃ yatsutā jātā duhitā na kathaṃcana .. 27 ..
5.127.d:
सकृन्मैधुनसंसर्गात्ततस्तीर्थप्रभावतः ..
सर्वासां यत्सुता जाता दुहिता न कथंचन .. 27 ..
5.127.m: from a single act of sexual union, by the power of that sacred ford, / sons were born to all of them, never a daughter.

5.127.s:
ye kecitputradā maṃtrāścātuścaraṇāsaṃbhavāḥ .
te sarve'tra vasiṣṭhena prayuktāḥ kṣattramicchatā .. 28 .
5.127.d:
ये केचित्पुत्रदा मंत्राश्चातुश्चरणासंभवाः .
ते सर्वेऽत्र वसिष्ठेन प्रयुक्ताः क्षत्त्रमिच्छता .. 28 .
5.127.m: Whatever mantras granting sons there are, born from the four quarters, / were all employed here by Vasiṣṭha when he desired kṣatriyas.

5.127.s:
daṃpatyoḥ snānamātreṇa jāte'tra syātsuputrakaḥ..
tasmātsuputradaṃnāma kuṇḍametannigadyate .. 29 ..
5.127.d:
दंपत्योः स्नानमात्रेण जातेऽत्र स्यात्सुपुत्रकः..
तस्मात्सुपुत्रदंनाम कुण्डमेतन्निगद्यते .. 29 ..
5.127.m: By mere ablution of the husband and wife here, an excellent son is born; / therefore, this pool is called 'Suputrada' (Grantor of Excellent Sons).

5.127.s:
tasmādbhāryāḥ samastāstā bṛhadbalasamudbhavāḥ ..
atra snānaṃ prakurvaṃtu yathoktavidhinā janāḥ .. 6.128.30 ..
5.127.d:
तस्माद्भार्याः समस्तास्ता बृहद्बलसमुद्भवाः ..
अत्र स्नानं प्रकुर्वंतु यथोक्तविधिना जनाः .. 6.128.30 ..
5.127.m: Therefore, O people, let all those wives left by Bṛhadbala / perform their ablution here according to the prescribed rite.

5.127.s:
naiva kiṃcidasatyaṃ syānna ca niṃdākaraṃ tathā ..
śrūyate ca yataḥ ślokaḥ pūrvācāryairudāhṛtaḥ .. 31 ..
5.127.d:
नैव किंचिदसत्यं स्यान्न च निंदाकरं तथा ..
श्रूयते च यतः श्लोकः पूर्वाचार्यैरुदाहृतः .. 31 ..
5.127.m: Nothing of this is untrue, nor is it blameworthy, / since a verse declared by ancient teachers is heard:

5.127.s:
adbhyo'gnirbrahmataḥ kṣattramaśmano lohamucchritam..
teṣāṃ sarvatragaṃ tejaḥ svāsu yoniṣu śāmyati .. 32 ..
5.127.d:
अद्भ्योऽग्निर्ब्रह्मतः क्षत्त्रमश्मनो लोहमुच्छ्रितम्..
तेषां सर्वत्रगं तेजः स्वासु योनिषु शाम्यति .. 32 ..
5.127.m: 'Fire comes from water, the kṣatriya order from the brahmin, iron arises from stone; / their energy, reaching everywhere, is pacified in their own sources.'

5.127.s:
tacchrutvā janāḥ sarve sacivānāṃ vacokhilam ..
tadācakhyurdrutaṃ gatvā satyasaṃdhasya bhūpateḥ .. 33 ..
5.127.d:
तच्छ्रुत्वा जनाः सर्वे सचिवानां वचोखिलम् ..
तदाचख्युर्द्रुतं गत्वा सत्यसंधस्य भूपतेः .. 33 ..
5.127.m: Having heard that, all the people went quickly / and related the ministers' and King Satyasandha's entire speech.

5.127.s:
tatastāḥ sarvaśo dārā brāhmaṇānatisundarān ..
ṛtusnātāḥ samājagmurnṛpapatnyaḥ suharṣitāḥ .. 34 ..
5.127.d:
ततस्ताः सर्वशो दारा ब्राह्मणानतिसुन्दरान् ..
ऋतुस्नाताः समाजग्मुर्नृपपत्न्यः सुहर्षिताः .. 34 ..
5.127.m: Then all those wives, the kings' consorts, overjoyed, / having bathed after their menses, approached very handsome brahmins.

5.127.s:
yatra tatputradaṃ tīrthaṃ vasiṣṭhena vinirmitam ..
tatra snātvā sakṛtsaṃgaṃ samāsādya dvijodbhavam .. 35 ..
5.127.d:
यत्र तत्पुत्रदं तीर्थं वसिष्ठेन विनिर्मितम् ..
तत्र स्नात्वा सकृत्संगं समासाद्य द्विजोद्भवम् .. 35 ..
5.127.m: Where that son-granting sacred ford was fashioned by Vasiṣṭha, / having bathed there, and having once had union with a twice-born,

5.127.s:
sarvāstāḥ putravatyaśca saṃjātā dvijasattamāḥ ..
āsīttasya nareṃdrasya śataṃ paṃcabhiranvitam .. 36 ..
5.127.d:
सर्वास्ताः पुत्रवत्यश्च संजाता द्विजसत्तमाः ..
आसीत्तस्य नरेंद्रस्य शतं पंचभिरन्वितम् .. 36 ..
5.127.m: all of them became mothers of sons, O best of the twice-born. / That king had one hundred and five [wives].

5.127.s: tāsāṃ samabhavadviprāḥ śataṃ paṃcādhikaṃ tathā .. 37 ..
5.127.d: तासां समभवद्विप्राः शतं पंचाधिकं तथा .. 37 ..
5.127.m: To them were born, O brahmins, likewise one hundred and five,

5.127.s:
pratyekaṃ varaputrāṇāṃ vaṃśavṛddhikaraṃ param ..
ānaṃdajananaṃ samyaksarveṣāṃ rāṣṭravāsinām .. 38 ..
5.127.d:
प्रत्येकं वरपुत्राणां वंशवृद्धिकरं परम् ..
आनंदजननं सम्यक्सर्वेषां राष्ट्रवासिनाम् .. 38 ..
5.127.m: each an excellent son, supremely furthering the lineage, / bringing great joy to all the inhabitants of the realm.

5.127.s:
tatra śreṣṭho'bhavatputro ya ānartapatirbhuvi ..
aṭonāma suvikhyātaḥ sarvaśatrunibarhaṇaḥ .. 39 ..
5.127.d:
तत्र श्रेष्ठोऽभवत्पुत्रो य आनर्तपतिर्भुवि ..
अटोनाम सुविख्यातः सर्वशत्रुनिबर्हणः .. 39 ..
5.127.m: Among them, the eldest son was he who became the lord of Ānarta on earth, / renowned by the name Aṭa, the destroyer of all enemies,

5.127.s:
aṭeśvaraiti khyāto yena devo'tra nirmitaḥ ..
subhaktyā yena dṛṣṭena vaṃśocchittirna jāyate .. 6.128.40 ..
5.127.d:
अटेश्वरैति ख्यातो येन देवोऽत्र निर्मितः ..
सुभक्त्या येन दृष्टेन वंशोच्छित्तिर्न जायते .. 6.128.40 ..
5.127.m: by whom the deity called Aṭeśvara was established here, / beheld with true devotion, no extinction of lineage occurs.

5.127.s:
.. ṛṣaya ūcuḥ .. ..
kasmāttasya kṛtaṃ nāma etaccā'ṭa iti smṛtam ..
anvayena parityaktaṃ tasmātkīrtaya sūtaja ..41..
5.127.d:
.. ऋषय ऊचुः .. ..
कस्मात्तस्य कृतं नाम एतच्चाऽट इति स्मृतम् ..
अन्वयेन परित्यक्तं तस्मात्कीर्तय सूतज ..41..
5.127.m: The seers said: / Why was this name of his, known as Aṭa, given, / devoid of family tradition? Tell that, O son of Sūta.

5.127.s:
sacivairbrāhmaṇairvāpi tasyaitannāma nirmitam ..
mātrā vā tatsamācakṣva paraṃ kautūhalaṃ hi naḥ .. 42 ..
5.127.d:
सचिवैर्ब्राह्मणैर्वापि तस्यैतन्नाम निर्मितम् ..
मात्रा वा तत्समाचक्ष्व परं कौतूहलं हि नः .. 42 ..
5.127.m: Was this name given to him by the ministers, or by brahmins, / or by his mother? Tell that, for our curiosity is indeed great.

5.127.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
na mātrā tatkṛtaṃ nāma na vipraiḥ sacivairnṛpa ..
tatkṛtaṃ devadūtena vyomasthena dvijottamāḥ .. 43 ..
5.127.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
न मात्रा तत्कृतं नाम न विप्रैः सचिवैर्नृप ..
तत्कृतं देवदूतेन व्योमस्थेन द्विजोत्तमाः .. 43 ..
5.127.m: Sūta said: / That name was not given by his mother, nor by brahmins or ministers, O king; / it was given by a messenger of the gods abiding in the sky, O best of the twice-born.

5.127.s:
yathā tathā pravakṣyāmi śrotavyaṃ susamāhitaiḥ ..
yayā sa bhūpatirjāto daśārṇādhipateḥ sutā .. 49 ..
sā rūpayauvanopetā rūpāḍhyaṃ prāpya saddvijam ..
prasthitā snātukāmātha putratīrthe mṛgekṣaṇā .. 45 ..
sahitā tena vipreṇa kaṃdarpapratimena ca ..
atha tābhyāṃ mahānrāmo mithaḥ saṃdarśanātsthitaḥ .. 46 ..
tādṛṅmātraṃ sukṛcchreṇa prāptaṃ tīrthaṃ sutapradam ..
tataḥ snātvā jale tasminniṣkrāṃtau tau sukāmukau ..47..
vrajamānau ca mārge'pi kāmadharmamupāgatau ..
atyautsukyātsusaṃhṛṣṭau lajjāṃ tyaktvā sudūrataḥ .. 48 ..
niṃdamānasya lokasya vicchedavacanaistadā ..
vīryotsarge'tha saṃjāte yāvaduttiṣṭhate dvijaḥ .. 49 ..
5.127.d:
यथा तथा प्रवक्ष्यामि श्रोतव्यं सुसमाहितैः ..
यया स भूपतिर्जातो दशार्णाधिपतेः सुता .. 49 ..
सा रूपयौवनोपेता रूपाढ्यं प्राप्य सद्द्विजम् ..
प्रस्थिता स्नातुकामाथ पुत्रतीर्थे मृगेक्षणा .. 45 ..
सहिता तेन विप्रेण कंदर्पप्रतिमेन च ..
अथ ताभ्यां महान्रामो मिथः संदर्शनात्स्थितः .. 46 ..
तादृङ्मात्रं सुकृच्छ्रेण प्राप्तं तीर्थं सुतप्रदम् ..
ततः स्नात्वा जले तस्मिन्निष्क्रांतौ तौ सुकामुकौ ..47..
व्रजमानौ च मार्गेऽपि कामधर्ममुपागतौ ..
अत्यौत्सुक्यात्सुसंहृष्टौ लज्जां त्यक्त्वा सुदूरतः .. 48 ..
निंदमानस्य लोकस्य विच्छेदवचनैस्तदा ..
वीर्योत्सर्गेऽथ संजाते यावदुत्तिष्ठते द्विजः .. 49 ..
5.127.m:
I shall tell how that happened; it should be heard with attentive minds. / The one by whom that king was born was the daughter of the lord of Daśārṇa.
Endowed with beauty and youth, having obtained a noble twice-born rich in beauty, / that deer-eyed lady set forth, wishing to bathe in the Putra-tīrtha,
accompanied by that brahmin who resembled Kāmadeva. / Then between the two, a great passion arose from looking upon each other.
Just then, with great difficulty, the son-granting sacred ford was reached; / then, having bathed in that water, the two lovers emerged.
And while walking even on the road, they engaged in the ways of passion, / exceedingly delighted out of intense longing, casting shame far aside,
despite the people rebuking them with interrupted words of censure. / Then, when the emission of semen occurred, as the twice-born stood up,

5.127.s:
tāvadākāśagā vāṇī sahasā devanirmitā ..
aṭatārājamārgeṇa vipreṇānena vai yataḥ .. 6.128.50 ..
5.127.d:
